translations.literal: Shen Xuanyi and Shen Jie of Wu Commandery with troops besieged Suzhou; Regional Inspector Huangfu Ji fought repeatedly without success, and Su led troops to rescue him.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Xuanyi and Shen Jie of Wu Commandery with troops besieged Suzhou; Regional Inspector Huangfu Ji fought repeatedly without success, and Su led troops to rescue him, the record states.

sentences.zh: 玄懀勢迫，走投南沙賊帥陸孟孫。

translations.literal: Xuanyi's situation was desperate; he fled to throw himself on the Nansha bandit chief Lu Mengsun.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanyi's situation was desperate; he fled to throw himself on the Nansha bandit chief Lu Mengsun, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素擊孟孫于松江，大破之，禽孟孫、玄懀。

translations.literal: Su attacked Mengsun at Song River, greatly defeated him, and captured Mengsun and Xuanyi.
translations.idiomatic: Su attacked Mengsun at Song River, greatly defeated him, and captured Mengsun and Xuanyi, the record states.

sentences.zh: 黝、歙賊帥沈雪、沈能據柵自固，又攻拔之。

translations.literal: The bandit chiefs Shen Xue and Shen Neng of You and She held camps and defended themselves firmly; he again attacked and took them.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit chiefs Shen Xue and Shen Neng of You and She held camps and defended themselves firmly; he again attacked and took them, the record states.

sentences.zh: 江浙賊高智慧自號東揚州刺史，吳州總管五原西元契鎮會稽，以其兵盛而降之。

translations.literal: The Jiang-Zhe bandit Gao Zhihui styled himself Regional Inspector of Eastern Yangzhou; Area Commander of Wu Province Wuyuan Xi Yuanqi garrisoned Kuaiji and submitted to him because his troops were strong.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiang-Zhe bandit Gao Zhihui styled himself regional inspector of Eastern Yangzhou; area commander of Wu Province Wuyuan Xi Yuanqi garrisoned Kuaiji and submitted to him because his troops were strong.

sentences.zh: 智慧盡屠其眾，契自殺。

translations.literal: Zhihui slaughtered all his troops to the last man; Yuanqi killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihui slaughtered all his troops to the last man; Yuanqi killed himself, the record states.

sentences.zh: 智慧有船艦千餘艘，屯據要害，兵甚勁。

translations.literal: Zhihui had more than a thousand ships, stationed at strategic points, and his troops were very strong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihui had more than a thousand ships, stationed at strategic points, and his troops were very strong, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素擊之，自旦至申，苦戰破之。

translations.literal: Su attacked him; from dawn to the hour of shen he fought bitterly and broke him.
translations.idiomatic: Su attacked him; from dawn to the hour of shen he fought bitterly and broke him, the record states.

sentences.zh: 智慧逃入海。

translations.literal: Zhihui fled into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihui fled into the sea, the record states.

sentences.zh: 躡之，從餘姚泛海趣永嘉。

translations.literal: Su pursued him, going from Yuyao by sea toward Yongjia.
translations.idiomatic: Su pursued him, going from Yuyao by sea toward Yongjia, the record states.

sentences.zh: 智慧來拒戰，素擊走，賊帥汪文進自稱天子，據東陽，署其徒蔡道人為司空，守樂安。

translations.literal: Zhihui came to resist in battle; Su attacked and drove him off. The bandit chief Wang Wenjin styled himself Son of Heaven, held Dongyang, and appointed his follower Cai Daoren Minister of Works to guard Le'an.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihui came to resist in battle; Su attacked and drove him off. The bandit chief Wang Wenjin styled himself Son of Heaven, held Dongyang, and appointed his follower Cai Daoren Minister of Works to guard Le'an, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素進討。

translations.literal: Su advanced to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Su advanced to attack, the record states.

sentences.zh: 悉平之。

translations.literal: He pacified them all.
translations.idiomatic: He pacified them all alike.

sentences.zh: 又破永嘉賊帥沈孝徹。

translations.literal: He also defeated the Yongjia bandit chief Shen Xiaoche.
translations.idiomatic: He also defeated the Yongjia bandit chief Shen Xiaoche, the record states.

sentences.zh: 於是步道向天臺，指臨海郡。

translations.literal: Thereupon he marched overland toward Tiantai and directed his course at Linhai Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Then he marched overland toward Tiantai and directed his course at Linhai Commandery.

sentences.zh: 遂捕遺逸，前後百餘戰，智慧遁守閩越。

translations.literal: He then captured fugitives; before and after more than a hundred battles, Zhihui fled and held out in Min-Yue.
translations.idiomatic: He then captured fugitives; before and after more than a hundred battles, Zhihui fled and held out in Min-Yue, the record states.

sentences.zh: 上以素久勞於外，詔令馳傳入朝，加子玄感上開府，賜彩八千段。

translations.literal: Because Su had long labored outside, an edict ordered him to enter court by relay post; his son Xuangan was given Upper Opening General and eight thousand lengths of brocade.
translations.idiomatic: Because Su had long labored outside, an edict ordered him to enter court by relay post; his son Xuangan was given upper opening general and eight thousand lengths of brocade.

sentences.zh: 素以餘寇未殄，恐為後患，又自請行。

translations.literal: Su, because remaining bandits were not yet destroyed and feared they would become a later trouble, again requested to go on campaign himself.
translations.idiomatic: Su, because remaining bandits were not yet destroyed and feared they would become a later trouble, again requested to go on campaign himself, the record states.

sentences.zh: 詔以素為元帥，復乘傳至會稽。

translations.literal: An edict made Su Field Marshal; he again rode relay post to Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Su field marshal; he again rode relay post to Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 先是，泉州人王國慶，南安豪族也，殺刺史劉弘，據州為亂。

translations.literal: Earlier Wang Guoqing of Quanzhou, a powerful clan of Nan'an, had killed Regional Inspector Liu Hong and seized the province in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Wang Guoqing of Quanzhou, a powerful clan of Nan'an, had killed Regional Inspector Liu Hong and seized the province in rebellion, the record states.

sentences.zh: 自以海路艱阻，非北人所習，不設備伍。

translations.literal: He considered the sea route difficult and treacherous and not what northerners were accustomed to, and did not set up defensive units.
translations.idiomatic: He considered the sea route difficult and treacherous and not what northerners were accustomed to, and did not set up defensive units, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素泛海奄至，國慶遑遽，棄州走。

translations.literal: Su crossed the sea and suddenly arrived; Guoqing was flustered and abandoned the province and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Su crossed the sea and suddenly arrived; Guoqing was flustered and abandoned the province and fled, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素分遣諸將，水陸追捕。

translations.literal: Su dispatched the various generals to pursue by land and sea.
translations.idiomatic: Su dispatched the various generals to pursue by land and sea, the record states.

sentences.zh: 時南海先有五六百家，居水為亡命，號曰遊艇子；

translations.literal: At that time in Nanhai there were already five or six hundred households living on the water as fugitives, called the Wandering Boat People;
translations.idiomatic: At that time in Nanhai there were already five or six hundred households living on the water as fugitives, known as the Wandering Boat People;

sentences.zh: 智慧、國慶欲往依之。

translations.literal: Zhihui and Guoqing wished to go and rely on them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihui and Guoqing wished to go and rely on them, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素乃密令人說國慶，令斬智慧以自效。

translations.literal: Su therefore secretly sent someone to persuade Guoqing to kill Zhihui to prove his merit.
translations.idiomatic: Su therefore secretly sent someone to persuade Guoqing to kill Zhihui to prove his merit, the record states.

sentences.zh: 因慶乃斬智慧於泉州。

translations.literal: Because of this Guoqing then beheaded Zhihui at Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this Guoqing then beheaded Zhihui at Quanzhou, the record states.

sentences.zh: 自余支黨悉降，江南大定。

translations.literal: The remaining branches and factions all submitted; the Jiangnan region was greatly settled.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining branches and factions all submitted; the Jiangnan region was greatly settled, the record states.

sentences.zh: 上遣左領軍將軍獨孤陀至浚儀迎勞，比到京師，問者日至。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Left Palace Commander Dugu Tuo to Junyi to welcome and reward him; by the time he reached the capital, visitors came daily to inquire.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Left Palace Commander Dugu Tuo to Junyi to welcome and reward him; by the time he reached the capital, visitors came daily to inquire, the record states.

sentences.zh: 拜素子玄獎儀同，賜黃金四十斤，加銀瓶，實以金錢，縑三千段、馬二百匹、羊三千口、田百頃、宅一區。

translations.literal: Su's son Xuanjiang was appointed Honors Equal; he was given forty jin of gold, with a silver bottle filled with gold coins added, three thousand bolts of silk, two hundred horses, three thousand sheep, a hundred qing of fields, and one residence.
translations.idiomatic: Su's son Xuanjiang was appointed honors equal; he was given forty jin of gold, with a silver bottle filled with gold coins added, three thousand bolts of silk, two hundred horses, three thousand sheep, a hundred qing of fields, and one residence.

sentences.zh: 代蘇威為尚書右僕射，與高熲專掌朝政。

translations.literal: He replaced Su Wei as Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and with Gao Jiong exclusively managed court government.
translations.idiomatic: He replaced Su Wei as right vice director of the Masters of Writing and with Gao Jiong exclusively managed court government.

sentences.zh: 素性疏而辯，高下在心，朝貴之內，頗推高熲，敬牛弘，厚接薛道衡，視蘇威蔑如也。

translations.literal: Su's nature was careless yet eloquent; high and low were in his heart; among the court nobility he fairly elevated Gao Jiong, respected Niu Hong, treated Xue Daoheng generously, and looked on Su Wei with contempt.
translations.idiomatic: Su's nature was careless yet eloquent; high and low were in his heart; among the court nobility he fairly elevated Gao Jiong, respected Niu Hong, treated Xue Daoheng generously, and looked on Su Wei with contempt, the record states.

sentences.zh: 自餘朝臣，多被陵轢。

translations.literal: The remaining court ministers were mostly bullied and insulted by him.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining court ministers were mostly bullied and insulted by him, the record states.

sentences.zh: 其才藝風調，優於高熲。

translations.literal: In talent, artistry, and bearing he was superior to Gao Jiong.
translations.idiomatic: In talent, artistry, and bearing he was superior to Gao Jiong, the record states.

sentences.zh: 至於推誠體國，處物平當，有宰相識度，不如熲遠矣。

translations.literal: But in giving one's heart in sincerity and embodying the state, in handling things with fairness and balance, and in the discernment of a chief minister, he was far inferior to Jiong.
translations.idiomatic: But in giving one's heart in sincerity and embodying the state, in handling things with fairness and balance, and in the discernment of a chief minister, he was far inferior to Jiong, the record states.

sentences.zh: 尋令素監營仁壽宮，素遂夷山堙穀，督役嚴急，作者多死，宮側時聞鬼哭。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was ordered to supervise construction of Renshou Palace; Su then leveled mountains and filled valleys, supervising labor with harsh urgency; many workers died, and beside the palace one sometimes heard ghosts weeping.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was ordered to supervise construction of Renshou Palace; Su then leveled mountains and filled valleys, supervising labor with harsh urgency; many workers died, and beside the palace one sometimes heard ghosts weeping, the record states.

sentences.zh: 及宮成，上令高熲前視，奏稱頗傷綺麗，大損人丁。

translations.literal: When the palace was completed, the emperor had Gao Jiong go to inspect it first; he reported that it was rather excessively ornate and had greatly wasted manpower.
translations.idiomatic: When the palace was completed, the emperor had Gao Jiong go to inspect it first; he reported that it was rather excessively ornate and had greatly wasted manpower, the record states.

sentences.zh: 帝不悅。

translations.literal: The emperor was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took displeasure.

sentences.zh: 素懼，即於北門啟獨孤皇后曰：「帝王法有離宮別館，今天下太平，造一宮何足損費。

translations.literal: Su was afraid and immediately at the North Gate reported to Empress Dowager Dugu, saying, "The law of emperors and kings provides for detached palaces and separate halls; now the realm is at peace — building one palace is hardly enough to waste resources."
translations.idiomatic: Su was afraid and immediately at the North Gate reported to Empress Dowager Dugu, saying, "The law of emperors and kings provides for detached palaces and separate halls; now the realm is at peace — building one palace can hardly be called wasting resources."

sentences.zh: 」後以此理諭上，上乃解。

translations.literal: The empress later used this reasoning to persuade the emperor, and the emperor thereupon relented.
translations.idiomatic: The empress later used this reasoning to persuade the emperor, and the emperor then relented.

sentences.zh: 於是賜錢百萬、綿絹三千段。

translations.literal: Thereupon he was given a million coins and three thousand lengths of cotton silk.
translations.idiomatic: Then he was given a million coins and three thousand lengths of cotton silk.

sentences.zh: 開皇十八年，突厥達頭可汗犯塞，以素為靈州道行軍總管。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Kaihuang, Tardush Khan of the Turks invaded the frontier; Su was made Field Headquarters Commander of the Lingzhou Route.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Kaihuang, Tardush Khan of the Turks invaded the frontier; Su was made field headquarters commander of the Lingzhou route.

sentences.zh: 出塞討之，賜物二千段、黃金百斤。

translations.literal: He went beyond the frontier to attack them and was given two thousand lengths of goods and a hundred jin of gold.
translations.idiomatic: He went beyond the frontier to attack them and was given two thousand lengths of goods and a hundred jin of gold, the record states.

sentences.zh: 先是諸將與虜戰，每慮胡騎奔突，皆戎車步騎相參，與鹿角為方陣，騎在內。

translations.literal: Earlier when the generals fought the barbarians, they always feared the barbarian horsemen would charge; chariots, infantry, and cavalry were mixed together in a square formation with antlers, with the cavalry inside.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier when the generals fought the barbarians, they always feared the barbarian horsemen would charge; chariots, infantry, and cavalry were mixed together in a square formation with antlers, with the cavalry inside, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素曰：「此乃自固之道。

translations.literal: Su said, "This is merely the way to defend oneself."
translations.idiomatic: Su said, "That is merely a way to defend oneself."

sentences.zh: 」於是悉除舊法，令諸軍為騎陣。

translations.literal: Thereupon he completely abolished the old methods and ordered all armies to form cavalry formations.
translations.idiomatic: Then he completely abolished the old methods and ordered all armies to form cavalry formations.

sentences.zh: 達頭聞之，大喜，以為天賜，下馬仰天而拜，率精騎十餘萬至。

translations.literal: When Tardush heard this he was greatly pleased, thinking it a gift from Heaven; he dismounted, bowed to Heaven, and came with more than a hundred thousand elite horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: When Tardush heard this he was greatly pleased, thinking it a gift from Heaven; he dismounted, bowed to Heaven, and came with more than a hundred thousand elite horsemen, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素奮擊，大破。

translations.literal: Su struck vigorously and greatly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Su struck vigorously and greatly defeated them, the record states.

sentences.zh: 達頭被重創而遁，眾號哭而去。

translations.literal: Tardush suffered heavy wounds and fled; his troops wailed and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Tardush suffered heavy wounds and fled; his troops wailed and departed, the record states.

sentences.zh: 優詔賜縑二萬匹及萬釘寶帶，加子玄感位大將軍，玄獎、玄縱、積善並上儀同。

translations.literal: A gracious edict gave twenty thousand bolts of silk and a precious belt studded with ten thousand nails; his son Xuangan was given the rank of General-in-Chief, and Xuanjiang, Xuanzong, and Jishan were all given Upper Honors Equal.
translations.idiomatic: A gracious edict gave twenty thousand bolts of silk and a precious belt studded with ten thousand nails; his son Xuangan was given the rank of general-in-chief, and Xuanjiang, Xuanzong, and Jishan were all given upper honors equal.

sentences.zh: 素多權略，乘機赴敵，應變無方。

translations.literal: Su had many stratagems; seizing opportunities to meet the enemy, he responded to changes without fixed method.
translations.idiomatic: Su had many stratagems; seizing opportunities to meet the enemy, he responded to changes without fixed method, the record states.

sentences.zh: 然大抵馭戎嚴整，有犯令者，立斬無所寬貸。

translations.literal: Yet in general he controlled the army with strict order; those who violated commands were beheaded on the spot without leniency.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in general he controlled the army with strict order; those who violated commands were beheaded on the spot without leniency, the record states.

sentences.zh: 每將臨寇，輒求人過失而斬之，多者百餘人，少不下數十，流血盈前，言笑自若。

translations.literal: Whenever he was about to face the enemy, he would seek men's faults and behead them — more than a hundred in some cases, never fewer than several dozen; blood filled the ground before him, yet he talked and laughed as if at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he was about to face the enemy, he would seek men's faults and behead them — more than a hundred in some cases, never fewer than several dozen; blood filled the ground before him, yet he talked and laughed as if at ease, the record states.

sentences.zh: 及對陣，先令一二百人赴敵，陷陣則已，如不能陷而還，無問多少，悉斬之。

translations.literal: When facing battle, he first ordered one or two hundred men to charge the enemy; if they broke the formation that was that, but if they could not break through and returned, without asking how many, all were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: When facing battle, he first ordered one or two hundred men to charge the enemy; if they broke the formation that was that, but if they could not break through and returned, without asking how many, all were beheaded, the record states.

sentences.zh: 又令二百人復進，還如向法。

translations.literal: He then ordered two hundred men to advance again; if they returned it was by the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered two hundred men to advance again; if they returned it was by the same rule, the record states.

sentences.zh: 將士股栗，有必死心，由是戰無不勝，稱為名將。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers trembled in the thighs and had hearts resolved on death; because of this he was victorious in every battle and was called a famous general.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers trembled in the thighs and had hearts resolved on death; because of this he was victorious in every battle and was called a famous general, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素時貴幸，言無不從。

translations.literal: Su at that time was favored and trusted; nothing he said went unheeded.
translations.idiomatic: Su at that time was favored and trusted; nothing he said went unheeded, the record states.

sentences.zh: 其從素征代者，微功必錄。

translations.literal: Those who followed Su in campaigns against the northern barbarians had even slight merit recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Those who followed Su in campaigns against the northern barbarians had even slight merit recorded, the record states.

sentences.zh: 至於他將，雖大功，多為文吏所譴卻。

translations.literal: As for other generals, even for great merit they were mostly rejected by the civil officials.
translations.idiomatic: As for other generals, even for great merit they were mostly rejected by the civil officials, the record states.

sentences.zh: 故素雖嚴忍，士亦以此願從。

translations.literal: Therefore although Su was harsh and cruel, soldiers for this reason were willing to follow him.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore although Su was harsh and cruel, soldiers for this reason were willing to follow him, the record states.

sentences.zh: 二十年，晉王廣為靈、朔道行軍元帥，素為長史，王卑躬交素。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, Prince of Jin Guang was Field Marshal of the Ling and Shuo Route Mobile Headquarters, and Su was Chief Clerk; the prince bowed humbly in treating Su.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, Prince of Jin Guang was field marshal of the Ling and Shuo route mobile headquarters, and Su was chief clerk; the prince bowed humbly in treating Su.

sentences.zh: 及為太子，素之謀也。

translations.literal: When he became crown prince, it was Su's plotting.
translations.idiomatic: When he became crown prince, it was Su's plotting, the record states.

sentences.zh: 仁壽初，代高熲為尚書左僕射，賜良馬十匹、牝馬二百匹、奴婢百口。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Renshou he replaced Gao Jiong as Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and was given ten fine horses, two hundred mares, and a hundred male and female servants.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Renshou he replaced Gao Jiong as left vice director of the Masters of Writing and was given ten fine horses, two hundred mares, and a hundred male and female servants.

sentences.zh: 其年，以素為行軍元帥，出雲中擊突厥，連破之。

translations.literal: That year Su was made Field Marshal, went out from Yunzhong to attack the Turks, and defeated them repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: That year Su was made field marshal, went out from Yunzhong to attack the Turks, and defeated them repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 突厥走，追至夜及之。

translations.literal: The Turks fled; he pursued them and caught up by night.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks fled; he pursued them and caught up by night, the record states.

sentences.zh: 將復戰，恐賊越逸，令其騎稍後，於是親將兩騎並降突厥二人與虜並行，不之覺也。

translations.literal: About to fight again, fearing the bandits would escape over the frontier, he ordered his cavalry to hang back; he personally led two horsemen together with two surrendered Turks to ride alongside the enemy without their noticing.
translations.idiomatic: About to fight again, fearing the bandits would escape over the frontier, he ordered his cavalry to hang back; he personally led two horsemen together with two surrendered Turks to ride alongside the enemy without their noticing, the record states.

sentences.zh: 侯其頓舍未定，趣後騎掩擊，大破之。

translations.literal: Waiting until their camp was not yet settled, he urged the rear cavalry to strike by surprise and greatly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Waiting until their camp was not yet settled, he urged the rear cavalry to strike by surprise and greatly defeated them, the record states.

sentences.zh: 自是突厥遠遁，磧南無復虜庭。

translations.literal: From this the Turks fled far away, and south of the desert there was no longer a barbarian court.
translations.idiomatic: From this the Turks fled far away, and south of the desert there was no longer a barbarian court, the record states.

sentences.zh: 以功進子玄感位柱國，玄縱為淮南郡公，賞物二萬段。

translations.literal: For merit his son Xuangan's rank was advanced to Pillar of State, Xuanzong was made Duke of Huainan Commandery, and he was given twenty thousand lengths of goods.
translations.idiomatic: For merit his son Xuangan's rank was advanced to pillar of state, Xuanzong was made Duke of Huainan, and he was given twenty thousand lengths of goods.

sentences.zh: 及獻皇后崩，山陵制度多出於素。

translations.literal: When Empress Dowager Xian died, the mountain tomb regulations mostly came from Su.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Dowager Xian died, the mountain tomb regulations mostly came from Su, the record states.

sentences.zh: 上善之，下詔曰：「君為元首，臣則股肱，共理百姓，義同一體。

translations.literal: The emperor approved and issued an edict saying, "The ruler is the head, ministers are the arms and legs; together they govern the hundred surnames, their duty one body."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved and issued an edict saying, "The ruler is the head and ministers the arms and legs; together they govern the hundred surnames, their duty one body."

sentences.zh: 上柱國、尚書左僕射、仁壽宮大監、越國公素，志度恢弘，機鑒明遠，懷佐時之略，包經國之才。

translations.literal: Upper Pillar of State, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Grand Supervisor of Renshou Palace, Duke of Yue State Su — his resolve and measure are broad, his insight clear and far-reaching; he holds strategies to assist the age and talent to manage the state.
translations.idiomatic: Upper pillar of state, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, grand supervisor of Renshou Palace, Duke of Yue Su — his resolve and measure are broad, his insight clear and far-reaching; he holds strategies to assist the age and talent to manage the state.

sentences.zh: 王業初基，霸圖肇建，策名委質，受脤出師，禽翦凶魁，克平虢、鄭。

translations.literal: When the royal enterprise was first founded and the hegemonic design newly established, he registered his name and devoted his substance, received the sacrificial flesh and went out as commander, captured and cut down the fierce chiefs, and conquered and pacified Guo and Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: When the royal enterprise was first founded and the hegemonic design newly established, he registered his name and devoted his substance, received the sacrificial flesh and went out as commander, captured and cut down the fierce chiefs, and conquered and pacified Guo and Zheng, the record states.

sentences.zh: 頻承廟算，揚旌江表；

translations.literal: Repeatedly receiving the temple's calculations, he raised banners south of the Yangzi;
translations.idiomatic: Again and again receiving the temple's calculations, he raised banners south of the Yangzi;

sentences.zh: 每稟戎律，長驅塞垣。

translations.literal: Whenever he received military law he drove far along the frontier wall.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he received military law he drove far along the frontier wall, the record states.

sentences.zh: 南指而吳越肅清，北臨而獯獫摧服。

translations.literal: Pointing south, Wu and Yue were cleared and pacified; facing north, the Xiongnu were broken and subdued.
translations.idiomatic: Pointing south, Wu and Yue were cleared and pacified; facing north, the Xiongnu were broken and subdued, the record states.

sentences.zh: 自居端揆，參贊機衡，當朝正色，直言無隱。

translations.literal: Once occupying the chief minister's seat, he assisted in the pivots of state, maintained upright color at court, and spoke directly without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Once occupying the chief minister's seat, he assisted in the pivots of state, maintained upright color at court, and spoke directly without concealment, the record states.

sentences.zh: 論文則詞藻從橫，語武則權奇間出，既文且武，唯朕所命。

translations.literal: In literature his words were brilliant and unrestrained; in martial affairs his stratagems were singular and emerged at intervals — both literary and martial, exactly as I command.
translations.idiomatic: In literature his words were brilliant and unrestrained; in martial affairs his stratagems were singular and emerged at intervals — both literary and martial, exactly as I command, the record states.

sentences.zh: 任使之處，夙夜無怠。

translations.literal: In the places where he is employed, he is never idle day or night.
translations.idiomatic: In the places where he is employed, he is never idle day or night, the record states.

sentences.zh: 獻皇后奄離六宮，遠日雲及，塋兆安厝，委素經紀。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Xian suddenly departed the six palaces; the distant day drew near, the tomb mound was settled and placed — all was entrusted to Su to manage.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Xian suddenly departed the six palaces; the distant day drew near, the tomb mound was settled and placed — all was entrusted to Su to manage, the record states.

sentences.zh: 然葬事依禮，唯卜泉石，至如吉凶，不由於此。

translations.literal: Yet burial affairs follow ritual — only spring stones are divined; as for fortune and misfortune, it does not depend on this.
translations.idiomatic: Yet burial affairs follow ritual — only spring stones are divined; as for fortune and misfortune, it does not depend on this, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素義存奉上，情深體國，欲使幽明俱泰，永保無窮。

translations.literal: Su's righteousness lay in serving above, his feeling deep in embodying the state; he wished to make dark and bright both at peace and preserve them forever without end.
translations.idiomatic: Su's righteousness lay in serving above, his feeling deep in embodying the state; he wished to make dark and bright both at peace and preserve them forever without end, the record states.

sentences.zh: 以為陰陽之書，聖人所作，禍福之理，特須審慎。

translations.literal: He considered that books of yin and yang were made by sages, and the principles of fortune and misfortune must especially be carefully examined.
translations.idiomatic: He considered that books of yin and yang were made by sages, and the principles of fortune and misfortune must especially be carefully examined, the record states.

sentences.zh: 乃遍曆川原，親自占擇，志圖元吉，孜孜不已。

translations.literal: He therefore went everywhere through rivers and plains, personally divining and selecting, striving for supreme good fortune, diligently without ceasing.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore went everywhere through rivers and plains, personally divining and selecting, striving for supreme good fortune, diligently without ceasing, the record states.

sentences.zh: 遂得神皋福壤，營建山陵。

translations.literal: He thus obtained divine highland and blessed soil and built the mountain tomb.
translations.idiomatic: He thus obtained divine highland and blessed soil and built the mountain tomb, the record states.

sentences.zh: 論素此心，事極誠孝，豈與平戎定寇，比其功業，若不加褒賞，何以申茲勸勵。

translations.literal: Considering Su's heart in this matter, his conduct was extremely sincere and filial — how could it be compared with pacifying barbarians and settling bandits for his achievements? If reward and praise are not added, how can this encouragement be expressed?
translations.idiomatic: Considering Su's heart in this matter, his conduct was extremely sincere and filial — how could that be compared with pacifying barbarians and settling bandits? If reward and praise are not added, how can such encouragement be expressed?

sentences.zh: 可別封一子義康郡公、邑萬戶，子子孫孫承襲不絕，餘如故。

translations.literal: One of his sons may separately be enfeoffed as Duke of Yikang Commandery with a fief of ten thousand households, to be inherited by sons and grandsons without end; the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: One of his sons may separately be enfeoffed as Duke of Yikang with a fief of ten thousand households, to be inherited by sons and grandsons without end; the rest as before.

sentences.zh: 」並賜田三十頃、絹萬匹、米萬石；

translations.literal: He was also given thirty qing of fields, ten thousand bolts of silk, and ten thousand shi of rice;
translations.idiomatic: He also received thirty qing of fields, ten thousand bolts of silk, and ten thousand shi of rice;

sentences.zh: 金缽一，實以金；

translations.literal: one gold bowl filled with gold;
translations.idiomatic: a gold bowl filled with gold;

sentences.zh: 銀缽一，實以珠；

translations.literal: one silver bowl filled with pearls;
translations.idiomatic: a silver bowl filled with pearls;

sentences.zh: 並綾錦五百段。

translations.literal: and five hundred lengths of damask and brocade.
translations.idiomatic: and five hundred lengths of damask and brocade, the record states.

sentences.zh: 時素貴寵日隆。

translations.literal: At that time Su's favor and privilege grew daily.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Su's favor and privilege grew daily, the record states.

sentences.zh: 其弟約、從父文思、弟紀及族父異並尚書、列卿，諸子無汗馬勞，位柱國、刺史。

translations.literal: His younger brother Yue, his father's younger cousin Wensi, his younger brother Ji, and his clan uncle Yi were all Ministers and Attendant-in-Ordinary; his sons without sweat-and-horse merit held ranks of Pillar of State and Regional Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Yue, his father's younger cousin Wensi, his younger brother Ji, and his clan uncle Yi were all ministers and attendant-in-ordinary; his sons without sweat-and-horse merit held ranks of pillar of state and regional inspector.

sentences.zh: 家僮數千，後庭妓妾曳綺羅者以千數；

translations.literal: Household slaves numbered in the thousands; concubines and entertainers trailing gauze and silk numbered in the thousands;
translations.idiomatic: Household slaves numbered in the thousands; concubines and entertainers trailing gauze and silk also numbered in the thousands;

sentences.zh: 第宅華侈，制擬宮禁。

translations.literal: Residences were luxurious and extravagant, modeled on the palace prohibitions.
translations.idiomatic: Residences were luxurious and extravagant, modeled on the palace prohibitions, the record states.

sentences.zh: 有鮑亨者善屬文，殷胄者工草隸，並江南士人，因高智慧沒為奴。

translations.literal: There were Bao Heng, skilled at composing prose, and Yin Zhou, adept at cursive and clerical script — both scholars of the Jiangnan region who because of Gao Zhihui had been taken as slaves.
translations.idiomatic: There were Bao Heng, skilled at composing prose, and Yin Zhou, adept at cursive and clerical script — both scholars of the Jiangnan region who because of Gao Zhihui had been taken as slaves, the record states.

sentences.zh: 親戚故吏，布列清顯。

translations.literal: Relatives and former subordinates were spread among prominent posts.
translations.idiomatic: Relatives and former subordinates were spread among prominent posts, the record states.

sentences.zh: 其盛近古未聞。

translations.literal: Such splendor had not been heard of in recent antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Such splendor had not been heard of in recent antiquity, the record states.

sentences.zh: 煬帝初為太子，忌蜀王秀，與素謀之，構成其罪，後竟廢黜。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yang had first been crown prince, he resented Prince of Shu Xiu; with Su he plotted and constructed his guilt, and in the end Xiu was deposed.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yang had first been crown prince, he resented Prince of Shu Xiu; with Su he plotted and constructed his guilt, and in the end Xiu was deposed, the record states.

sentences.zh: 朝臣有違忤者，雖至誠體國如賀若弼、史萬歲、李綱、柳彧等，素皆陰中之。

translations.literal: Court ministers who opposed him — even those who gave their hearts in sincerity and embodied the state like He Ruo Bi, Shi Wansui, Li Gang, and Liu Yu — Su all secretly struck at them.
translations.idiomatic: Court ministers who opposed him — even those who gave their hearts in sincerity and embodied the state like He Ruo Bi, Shi Wansui, Li Gang, and Liu Yu — Su all secretly struck at them, the record states.

sentences.zh: 若有附會及親戚，雖無才用，必加進擢。

translations.literal: If there were those who attached themselves to him or were kin, even without talent or ability, he certainly advanced and promoted them.
translations.idiomatic: If there were those who attached themselves to him or were kin, even without talent or ability, he certainly advanced and promoted them, the record states.

sentences.zh: 朝廷靡然，莫不畏附。

translations.literal: The court leaned in submission; none did not fear and attach themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The court leaned in submission; none did not fear and attach themselves, the record states.

sentences.zh: 唯兵部尚書柳述，以帝婿之重，數於上前面折素。

translations.literal: Only Minister of War Liu Shu, by weight of being the emperor's son-in-law, repeatedly rebuked Su before the emperor's face.
translations.idiomatic: Only Minister of War Liu Shu, by weight of being the emperor's son-in-law, repeatedly rebuked Su before the emperor's face, the record states.

sentences.zh: 大理卿梁毗，抗表言素作威作福。

translations.literal: Director of the Court of Justice Liang Pi submitted a memorial resisting Su for wielding authority and wielding favor.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Court of Justice Liang Pi submitted a memorial resisting Su for wielding authority and wielding favor, the record states.

sentences.zh: 上漸疏忌之，後因出敕曰：「僕射，國之宰輔，不可躬親細務，但三五日一度向省評論大事。

translations.literal: The emperor gradually grew distant and suspicious, and later issued an edict saying, "The Vice Director is the state's chief assistant and cannot personally attend to minor affairs — only once every three or five days come to the ministry to discuss great affairs."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor gradually grew distant and suspicious, and later issued an edict saying, "The vice director is the state's chief assistant and cannot personally attend to minor affairs — only once every three or five days come to the ministry to discuss great affairs."

sentences.zh: 」外示優崇，實奪之權，終仁壽之末，不復通判省事。

translations.literal: Outwardly showing superior honor, in reality stripping his power — by the end of Renshou he no longer jointly adjudicated ministry affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Outwardly showing superior honor, in reality stripping his power — by the end of Renshou he no longer jointly adjudicated ministry affairs, the record states.

sentences.zh: 上賜王公已下射，素箭為第一，上手以外國所獻金精盤價直巨萬以賜之。

translations.literal: The emperor granted archery to kings and dukes downward; Su's arrow was first, and the emperor with his own hand gave him a golden essence dish from a foreign state worth tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted archery to kings and dukes downward; Su's arrow was first, and the emperor with his own hand gave him a golden essence dish from a foreign state worth tens of thousands, the record states.

sentences.zh: 四年，從幸仁壽宮，宴賜重疊。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he followed the emperor's visit to Renshou Palace and received feasts and gifts in layers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he followed the emperor's visit to Renshou Palace and received feasts and gifts in layers, the record states.

sentences.zh: 及上不豫，素與兵部尚書柳述、黃門侍郎元岩等入侍疾。

translations.literal: When the emperor fell ill, Su together with Minister of War Liu Shu, Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Yellow Gate Yuan Yan, and others entered to attend the illness.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor fell ill, Su together with minister of war Liu Shu, attendant-in-ordinary of the yellow gate Yuan Yan, and others entered to attend the illness.

sentences.zh: 時皇太子入居大寶殿，慮上有不諱，須豫防擬，乃手自為書，封出問素。

translations.literal: At that time the crown prince entered and resided in the Great Treasure Hall; fearing the emperor might have an unfavorable turn, he needed to prepare defenses in advance, and personally wrote a letter, sealed it, and sent it out to ask Su.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the crown prince entered and resided in the Great Treasure Hall; fearing the emperor might have an unfavorable turn, he needed to prepare defenses in advance, and personally wrote a letter, sealed it, and sent it out to ask Su, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素條錄事狀，以報太子。

translations.literal: Su listed the circumstances item by item and reported to the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Su listed the circumstances item by item and reported to the crown prince, the record states.

sentences.zh: 宮人潛送於上，上覽而大恚。

translations.literal: A palace woman secretly sent it to the emperor; the emperor read it and was greatly enraged.
translations.idiomatic: A palace woman secretly sent it to the emperor; the emperor read it and was greatly enraged, the record states.

sentences.zh: 所寵陳貴人又言太子無禮。

translations.literal: The favored Lady Chen also said the crown prince was disrespectful.
translations.idiomatic: The favored Lady Chen also said the crown prince was disrespectful, the record states.

sentences.zh: 上遂發怒，欲召庶人勇。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon grew angry and wished to summon the commoner Yong.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then grew angry and wished to summon the commoner Yong.

sentences.zh: 太子謀之素，素矯詔追東宮兵士帖上臺宿衛，門禁出入，並取宇文述、郭衍節度。

translations.literal: The crown prince plotted with Su; Su forged an edict to recall Eastern Palace soldiers to garrison the upper platform in night watch; entry and exit at the gates were all taken under the command of Yuwen Shu and Guo Yan.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince plotted with Su; Su forged an edict to recall Eastern Palace soldiers to garrison the upper platform in night watch; entry and exit at the gates were all taken under the command of Yuwen Shu and Guo Yan, the record states.

sentences.zh: 又令張衡侍疾。

translations.literal: He also ordered Zhang Heng to attend the illness.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered Zhang Heng to attend the illness, the record states.

sentences.zh: 上以此日崩，由是頗有異論。

translations.literal: The emperor died on that day; because of this there were rather differing opinions.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor died on that day; because of this there were rather differing opinions, the record states.

sentences.zh: 會漢王諒反，遣茹茹天保往東蒲州，燒斷河橋，又遣王𨈭子並力拒守。

translations.literal: When Prince of Han Liang rebelled, he sent Ruru Tianbao to Dongpu Province to burn and break the river bridge, and also sent Wang Kui and others together to resist and hold.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince of Han Liang rebelled, he sent Ruru Tianbao to Dongpu Province to burn and break the river bridge, and also sent Wang Kui and others together to resist and hold, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素將輕騎五千襲之。

translations.literal: Su led five thousand light horsemen to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: Su led five thousand light horsemen to strike them, the record states.

sentences.zh: 潛於渭口宵濟，比明擊之。

translations.literal: He secretly crossed at night at Wei Ford; by dawn he attacked.
translations.idiomatic: He secretly crossed at night at Wei Ford; by dawn he attacked, the record states.

sentences.zh: 天保敗，𨈭子懼，以城降。

translations.literal: Tianbao was defeated; Kui was afraid and surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbao was defeated; Kui was afraid and surrendered the city, the record states.

sentences.zh: 有詔征還。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him recalled.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered him recalled, the record states.

sentences.zh: 初素將行，計日破賊，皆如所量。

translations.literal: When Su was about to go, he calculated the days to defeat the bandits, and all matched his reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: When Su was about to go, he calculated the days to defeat the bandits, and all matched his reckoning, the record states.

sentences.zh: 帝於是以素為并州道行軍總管、河北道安撫大使，討諒。

translations.literal: The emperor therefore made Su Field Headquarters Commander of the Bingzhou Route and Pacification Commissioner of the Hebei Route to attack Liang.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor therefore made Su field headquarters commander of the Bingzhou route and pacification commissioner of the Hebei route to attack Liang.

sentences.zh: 時晉、絳、呂三州並為諒城守，素各以二千人縻之而去。

translations.literal: At that time Jin, Jiang, and Lü, the three provinces, all held out for Liang; Su tied down each with two thousand men and departed.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Jin, Jiang, and Lü, the three provinces, all held out for Liang; Su tied down each with two thousand men and departed, the record states.

sentences.zh: 諒遣趙子開擁眾十餘萬，築絕徑路，屯據高壁，佈陣五十里。

translations.literal: Liang sent Zhao Zikai with more than a hundred thousand troops, building to cut off the narrow path, stationed holding the high ramparts, arraying troops for fifty li.
translations.idiomatic: Liang sent Zhao Zikai with more than a hundred thousand troops, building to cut off the narrow path, stationed holding the high ramparts, arraying troops for fifty li, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素令諸將以兵臨之，自以奇兵深入霍山，緣崖谷而進，直指其營，一戰破之，諒所署介州刺史梁修羅屯介休，聞素至，懼，棄城而走。

translations.literal: Su ordered the generals to press them with troops; he himself with elite troops went deep into Huo Mountain, followed cliff valleys and advanced, pointing straight at their camp, and broke them in one battle. Liang's appointed Regional Inspector of Jie Province Liang Xiuluo garrisoned Jiexiu; hearing Su had arrived, he was afraid and abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Su ordered the generators to press them with troops; he himself with elite troops went deep into Huo Mountain, followed cliff valleys and advanced, pointing straight at their camp, and broke them in one battle. Liang's appointed regional inspector of Jiezhou Liang Xiuluo garrisoned Jiexiu; hearing Su had arrived, he was afraid and abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 進至清源，去并州三十里。

translations.literal: Advancing to Qingyuan, thirty li from Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to Qingyuan, thirty li from Bing Province, the record states.

sentences.zh: 率其將王世宗、趙子開、蕭摩訶等來拒戰，又擊破之，禽蕭摩訶。

translations.literal: Liang's generals Wang Shizong, Zhao Zikai, Xiao Mohe, and others came to resist in battle; he again attacked and defeated them and captured Xiao Mohe.
translations.idiomatic: Liang's generals Wang Shizong, Zhao Zikai, Xiao Mohe, and others came to resist in battle; he again attacked and defeated them and captured Xiao Mohe, the record states.

sentences.zh: 退保并州，素進兵圍之。

translations.literal: They retreated to hold Bing Province; Su advanced and besieged it.
translations.idiomatic: They retreated to hold Bing Province; Su advanced and besieged it, the record states.

sentences.zh: 諒窮而降，餘黨悉平。

translations.literal: Liang was driven to extremity and surrendered; the remaining factions were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Liang was driven to extremity and surrendered; the remaining factions were all pacified, the record states.

sentences.zh: 帝遣素弟修武公約齎手詔勞，素上表陳謝。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Su's younger brother Duke of Xiuwu Yue bearing an imperial letter by hand to reward him; Su submitted a memorial of thanks.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Su's younger brother Duke of Xiuwu Yue bearing an imperial letter by hand to reward him; Su submitted a memorial of thanks, the record states.

sentences.zh: 其月，還京師。

translations.literal: That month he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That month he returned to the capital, the record states.

sentences.zh: 從駕幸洛陽，以素領營東京大監。

translations.literal: Following the emperor's visit to Luoyang, Su was appointed Grand Supervisor of the Eastern Capital Camp.
translations.idiomatic: Following the emperor's visit to Luoyang, Su was appointed grand supervisor of the Eastern Capital camp.

sentences.zh: 以平諒功，拜其子萬石、仁行、侄玄挺皆儀同三司，賚物五萬段、羅綺千匹、諒之妓妾二十人。

translations.literal: For merit in pacifying Liang, his sons Wanshi and Renxing and nephew Xuanting were all made Honors Equal to the Three Excellencies; he was given fifty thousand lengths of goods, a thousand bolts of silk gauze, and twenty of Liang's concubines and entertainers.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in pacifying Liang, his sons Wanshi and Renxing and nephew Xuanting were all made honors equal to the three excellencies; he was given fifty thousand lengths of goods, a thousand bolts of silk gauze, and twenty of Liang's concubines and entertainers.

sentences.zh: 大業元年，遷尚書令賜東京甲第一區、物二千段，尋拜太師，餘官如故。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daye he was transferred to Minister over the Masters of Writing and given one first-rank residence in the Eastern Capital and two thousand lengths of goods; soon afterward he was appointed Grand Preceptor, his other offices as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daye he was transferred to minister over the Masters of Writing and given one first-rank residence in the Eastern Capital and two thousand lengths of goods; soon afterward he was appointed grand preceptor, his other offices as before.

sentences.zh: 前後賞錫不可勝計。

translations.literal: Rewards and gifts before and after were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards and gifts before and after were beyond counting, the record states.

sentences.zh: 明年，拜司徒，改封楚公，真食二千五百戶。

translations.literal: The next year he was appointed Minister over the Masses, his enfeoffment changed to Duke of Chu, with a true fief of twenty-five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was appointed minister over the masses, his enfeoffment changed to Duke of Chu, with a true fief of twenty-five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 其年病薨，諡曰景武。

translations.literal: That year he died of illness; his posthumous name was Jingwu.
translations.idiomatic: That year he died of illness; his posthumous name was Jingwu (Stern and Martial).

sentences.zh: 贈光祿大夫、太尉公、弘農河東絳郡臨汾文城河內汲郡長平上黨河十郡太守，給轀輬車、班劍三十人、前後部羽葆鼓吹、粟麥五千石、物五千段，鴻臚監護喪事。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was awarded Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Duke of Grand Guardian, Grand Administrator of the ten commanderies of Hongnong, Hedong, Jiang, Fen, Wen, Cheng, Henei, Ji, Changping, Shangdang, and He, given a funeral carriage, thirty guards with swords, feathered parasols and drums before and behind, five thousand shi of millet and wheat, and five thousand lengths of goods; the Supervisor of Guests supervised the funeral rites.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was honored as grand master of splendid happiness, Duke of Grand Guardian, grand administrator of the ten commanderies of Hongnong, Hedong, Jiang, Fen, Wen, Cheng, Henei, Ji, Changping, Shangdang, and He, given a funeral carriage, thirty guards with swords, feathered parasols and drums before and behind, five thousand shi of millet and wheat, and five thousand lengths of goods; the supervisor of guests supervised the funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 帝又下詔立碑，以彰盛美。

translations.literal: The emperor also issued an edict to erect a stele to display the splendid beauty.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also issued an edict to erect a stele to display the splendid beauty, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素嘗以五言詩七百字贈番州刺史薛道衡，詞氣穎拔，風韻秀上，為一時盛作。

translations.literal: Su once gave a five-character poem of seven hundred characters to Regional Inspector of Fan Province Xue Daoheng; the wording was sharp and elevated, the tone elegant and superior — a masterpiece of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Su once gave a five-character poem of seven hundred characters to Regional Inspector of Fanzhou Xue Daoheng; the wording was sharp and elevated, the tone elegant and superior — a masterpiece of the age.

sentences.zh: 未幾而卒，道衡歎曰：「人之將死，其言也善，若是乎！

translations.literal: Before long he died; Daoheng sighed and said, "When a man is about to die, his words are good — is it like this!"
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was dead; Daoheng sighed and said, "When a man is about to die, his words are good — is it like this!"

sentences.zh: 」《集》十卷。

translations.literal: Collected Works in ten juan.
translations.idiomatic: Collected Works, ten juan.

sentences.zh: 素雖有建立策及平楊諒功，然特為帝猜忌，外示殊禮，內情甚薄。

translations.literal: Although Su had achievements in founding strategies and merit in pacifying Yang Liang, yet the emperor was especially suspicious of him; outwardly showing special courtesy, inwardly his feeling was very thin.
translations.idiomatic: Although Su had achievements in founding strategies and merit in pacifying Yang Liang, yet the emperor was especially suspicious of him; outwardly showing special courtesy, inwardly his feeling was very thin, the record states.

sentences.zh: 太史言楚分野有大喪，因改封素于楚。

translations.literal: The Grand Astrologer said the Chu asterism's territory would suffer a great mourning; therefore Su's enfeoffment was changed to Chu.
translations.idiomatic: The grand astrologer said the Chu asterism's territory would suffer a great mourning; therefore Su's enfeoffment was changed to Chu.

sentences.zh: 寢疾之日，帝每令名醫診侯，賜以上藥；

translations.literal: During his illness the emperor each day ordered famous physicians to examine him and gave him superior medicines;
translations.idiomatic: During his illness the emperor each day ordered famous physicians to examine him and gave him the finest medicines;

sentences.zh: 然密問醫人，恆恐不死。

translations.literal: Yet secretly he asked the physicians, always fearing Su would not die.
translations.idiomatic: Yet secretly he asked the physicians, always fearing Su would not die, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素又自知名位已極，不肯服藥，變不將慎。

translations.literal: Su also knew himself that fame and rank had reached their limit and refused to take medicine, no longer exercising caution.
translations.idiomatic: Su also knew himself that fame and rank had reached their limit and refused to take medicine, no longer exercising caution, the record states.

sentences.zh: 每語弟約曰：「我豈須更活邪？」

translations.literal: He often told his younger brother Yue, "Do I still need to live?"
translations.idiomatic: He often told his younger brother Yue, "Do I still need to live? — so he said."

sentences.zh: 素貪財貨，營求產業，東西京居宅侈麗，朝毀夕復，營繕無已。

translations.literal: Su was greedy for wealth and goods, scheming for property; residences in the eastern and western capitals were luxurious and splendid, destroyed in the morning and rebuilt in the evening, construction without end.
translations.idiomatic: Su was greedy for wealth and goods, scheming for property; residences in the eastern and western capitals were luxurious and splendid, destroyed in the morning and rebuilt in the evening, construction without end, the record states.

sentences.zh: 爰及諸方都會之處，邸店水磑田宅以千百數。

translations.literal: Extending to all major cities of the regions, inns, water mills, fields, and residences numbered in the hundreds and thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Extending to all major cities of the regions, inns, water mills, fields, and residences numbered in the hundreds and thousands, the record states.

sentences.zh: 時議以此鄙之。

translations.literal: Public opinion for this reason despised him.
translations.idiomatic: Public opinion therefore despised him.

sentences.zh: 子玄感。

translations.literal: His son Xuangan.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Xuangan.

sentences.zh: 玄感少時晚成，人多謂之癡。

translations.literal: Xuangan in youth matured late; many people called him dull.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan in youth matured late; many people called him dull, the record states.

sentences.zh: 唯素每謂所親曰：「此兒不癡也。

translations.literal: Only Su often told those close to him, "This boy is not dull."
translations.idiomatic: Only Su often told those close to him, "This boy is no dullard."

sentences.zh: 」及長，美須髯，儀貌雄俊，好讀書，便騎射。

translations.literal: When grown he had a fine beard and mustache, a heroic and handsome appearance, loved reading books, and was skilled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: When grown he had a fine beard and mustache, a heroic and handsome appearance, loved reading books, and was skilled at mounted archery, the record states.

sentences.zh: 弱冠，以父軍功位柱國，與其父俱為第二品，朝會則齊列。

translations.literal: At the capping age, because of his father's military merit he held the rank of Pillar of State; he and his father both held the second rank and at court assemblies stood in the same row.
translations.idiomatic: At the capping age, because of his father's military merit he held the rank of pillar of state; he and his father both held the second rank and at court assemblies stood in the same row.

sentences.zh: 後文帝命玄感降一等，玄感拜謝曰：「不意陛下寵臣之甚，許以公庭獲展私敬。

translations.literal: Later Emperor Wen ordered Xuangan reduced one rank; Xuangan bowed in thanks and said, "I did not expect Your Majesty to favor your subject so greatly as to permit private respect in the public court."
translations.idiomatic: Later Emperor Wen ordered Xuangan reduced one rank; Xuangan bowed in thanks and said, "I did not expect Your Majesty to favor me so greatly as to permit private respect in the public court."

sentences.zh: 」初拜郢州刺史，到官潛布耳目，察長吏能不，纖介必知，吏人敬服，皆稱其能。

translations.literal: When first appointed Regional Inspector of Ying Province, upon reaching his post he secretly deployed informants to observe whether the senior officials were capable; the slightest detail he always knew; officials and people respected and submitted, all calling him capable.
translations.idiomatic: When first appointed regional inspector of Yingzhou, upon reaching his post he secretly deployed informants to observe whether the senior officials were capable; the slightest detail he always knew; officials and people respected and submitted, all calling him capable.

sentences.zh: 後轉宋州刺史，父憂去職。

translations.literal: Later he was transferred to Regional Inspector of Song Province and left office for his father's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was transferred to regional inspector of Songzhou and left office for his father's mourning.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，拜鴻臚卿，襲爵楚公，遷禮部尚書。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was appointed Supervisor of Guests, inherited the dukedom of Chu, and was transferred to Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he was appointed supervisor of guests, inherited the dukedom of Chu, and was transferred to minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 性雖驕居，而愛重文學，四海知名之士多趨其門。

translations.literal: Although his nature was proud in station, he valued and honored literature; renowned scholars of the four seas mostly hastened to his gate.
translations.idiomatic: Although his nature was proud in station, he valued and honored literature; renowned scholars of the four seas mostly hastened to his gate, the record states.

sentences.zh: 後見朝綱漸紊，帝又猜忌日甚，內不自安，遂與諸弟潛謀廢帝立秦王浩。

translations.literal: Later seeing court discipline gradually disordered and the emperor's suspicion growing daily, inwardly he was not at ease and therefore with his younger brothers secretly plotted to depose the emperor and install Prince of Qin Hao.
translations.idiomatic: Later seeing court discipline gradually disordered and the emperor's suspicion growing daily, inwardly he was not at ease and therefore with his younger brothers secretly plotted to depose the emperor and install Prince of Qin Hao, the record states.

sentences.zh: 及從征吐谷渾，還至達鬥拔谷，時從官狼狽，玄感欲襲擊行宮。

translations.literal: When he followed the campaign against Tuyuhun and returned to Databagu, at that time the attendant officials were in disorder and Xuangan wished to strike the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: When he followed the campaign against Tuyuhun and returned to Databagu, at that time the attendant officials were in disorder and Xuangan wished to strike the traveling palace, the record states.

sentences.zh: 其叔慎曰：「士心尚一，國未有釁，不可圖也。

translations.literal: His uncle Shen said, "Men's hearts are still united and the state has no fissure — it cannot be plotted."
translations.idiomatic: His uncle Shen said, "Men's hearts are still united and the state has no crack — this cannot be plotted."

sentences.zh: 」玄感乃止。

translations.literal: Xuangan thereupon stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan then stopped.

sentences.zh: 時帝好征伐，玄感欲立威名，陰求將領，以告兵部尚書段文振。

translations.literal: At that time the emperor loved campaigns; Xuangan wished to establish a martial reputation and secretly sought generals, telling Minister of War Duan Wenzhen.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the emperor loved campaigns; Xuangan wished to establish a martial reputation and secretly sought generals, telling Minister of War Duan Wenzhen, the record states.

sentences.zh: 振以白帝，帝嘉之，謂群臣曰：「將門有將，故不虛也。

translations.literal: Wenzhen reported it to the emperor; the emperor commended him and told the ministers, "A general's house produces generals — it is not empty praise."
translations.idiomatic: Wenzhen reported it to the emperor; the emperor commended him and told the ministers, "A general's house produces generals — the saying is not empty."

sentences.zh: 」於是賚物千段，禮遇益隆，頗預朝政。

translations.literal: Thereupon he was given a thousand lengths of goods; courtesy and favor grew ever greater, and he fairly participated in court government.
translations.idiomatic: Then he was given a thousand lengths of goods; courtesy and favor grew ever greater, and he fairly participated in court government.

sentences.zh: 帝征遼東，令玄感黎陽督運。

translations.literal: When the emperor campaigned against Liaodong, he ordered Xuangan to supervise transport at Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor campaigned against Liaodong, he ordered Xuangan to supervise transport at Liyang, the record states.

sentences.zh: 遂與武賁郎將王仲伯、汲郡贊治趙懷義等謀，不時進發。

translations.literal: He then plotted with Brave Guard Attendant Wang Zhongbo, Assistant Administrator of Ji Commandery Zhao Huaiyi, and others not to advance on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: He then plotted with Brave Guard attendant Wang Zhongbo, assistant administrator of Ji Commandery Zhao Huaiyi, and others not to advance on schedule.

sentences.zh: 帝遣使者逼促，玄感揚言曰：「水路多盜，不可前後而發。

translations.literal: The emperor sent envoys to press him urgently; Xuangan proclaimed publicly, "There are many bandits on the water route — one cannot depart front and rear together."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent envoys to press him urgently; Xuangan proclaimed publicly, "There are many bandits on the water route — the front and rear cannot depart together."

sentences.zh: 」其弟武賁郎將玄縱、鷹揚郎將萬石並從幸遼東，玄感潛遣人召之。

translations.literal: His younger brothers Brave Guard Attendant Xuanzong and Hawkish Guard Attendant Wanshi were both following the emperor's visit to Liaodong; Xuangan secretly sent men to summon them.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brothers brave guard attendant Xuanzong and hawkish guard attendant Wanshi were both following the emperor's visit to Liaodong; Xuangan secretly sent men to summon them.

sentences.zh: 時來護兒以舟師自東萊，將入海趣平壤城，軍未發。

translations.literal: At that time Lai Huer with the fleet from Donglai was about to enter the sea and hurry to Pyongyang; the army had not yet set out.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Lai Huer with the fleet from Donglai was about to enter the sea and hurry to Pyongyang; the army had not yet set out, the record states.

sentences.zh: 玄感無以動眾，乃遣家奴偽為使，從東方來，謬稱護失軍期而反。

translations.literal: Xuangan had no means to move the masses; he therefore sent a household slave disguised as an envoy from the east to falsely say Huer had missed the army deadline and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan had no means to move the masses; he therefore sent a household slave disguised as an envoy from the east to falsely say Huer had missed the army deadline and rebelled, the record states.

sentences.zh: 玄感遂入黎陽縣，閉城大募勇夫。

translations.literal: Xuangan then entered Liyang County, closed the gates, and greatly recruited brave men.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan then entered Liyang County, closed the gates, and greatly recruited brave men, the record states.

sentences.zh: 於是取颿布為牟甲，署置官屬皆准開皇之舊。

translations.literal: Thereupon he took sailcloth for armor and appointed officials all according to the Kaihuang precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Then he took sailcloth for armor and appointed officials all according to the Kaihuang precedent.

sentences.zh: 移書傍郡以討護為名，令發兵會於倉所。

translations.literal: He sent letters to neighboring commanderies in the name of attacking Huer, ordering them to send troops to assemble at the granary.
translations.idiomatic: He sent letters to neighboring commanderies in the name of attacking Huer, ordering them to send troops to assemble at the granary, the record states.

sentences.zh: 以東光縣尉元務本為黎州刺史，趙懷義為衛州刺史，河內郡主簿唐禕為懷州刺史，有眾且一萬，將襲洛陽。

translations.literal: He made Dongguang County Lieutenant Yuan Wuben Regional Inspector of Li Province, Zhao Huaiyi Regional Inspector of Wei Province, and Henei Commandery Registrar Tang Yi Regional Inspector of Huai Province; with troops nearly ten thousand he was about to strike Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: He made Dongguang County lieutenant Yuan Wuben regional inspector of Li Province, Zhao Huaiyi regional inspector of Wei Province, and Henei commandery registrar Tang Yi regional inspector of Huai Province; with troops nearly ten thousand he was about to strike Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 唐禕至河內，馳往東都告之。

translations.literal: When Tang Yi reached Henei he galloped to the eastern capital to report it.
translations.idiomatic: When Tang Yi reached Henei he galloped to the eastern capital to report it, the record states.

sentences.zh: 越王侗、戶部尚書樊子蓋等勒兵備禦。

translations.literal: Prince of Yue Tong, Minister of Revenue Fan Zigai, and others mustered troops to defend.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yue Tong, Minister of Revenue Fan Zigai, and others mustered troops to defend, the record states.

sentences.zh: 修武縣人相率守臨清關，玄感不得濟，遂于汲郡南度河。

translations.literal: The people of Xiuwu County together held Linqing Pass; Xuangan could not cross and therefore crossed the river south of Ji Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Xiuwu County together held Linqing Pass; Xuangan could not cross and therefore crossed the river south of Ji Commandery, the record states.

sentences.zh: 從亂如市，數日，屯兵上春門，眾至十餘萬。

translations.literal: Those who followed the disorder were like a market; within several days he stationed troops at Shangchun Gate; the masses reached more than a hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Those who followed the disorder were like a market; within several days he stationed troops at Shangchun Gate; the masses reached more than a hundred thousand, the record states.

sentences.zh: 子蓋令河南贊務裴弘策拒之，弘策戰敗，父老競致牛酒。

translations.literal: Zigai ordered Henan Assistant Administrator Pei Hongce to resist him; Hongce was defeated in battle, and elders competed to present oxen and wine.
translations.idiomatic: Zigai ordered Henan assistant administrator Pei Hongce to resist him; Hongce was defeated in battle, and elders competed to present oxen and wine.

sentences.zh: 玄感屯兵尚書省，每有誓眾曰：「我身為上柱國，家累巨萬金，至富貴，無所求也。

translations.literal: Xuangan stationed troops at the Ministry of the Masters of Writing; whenever he rallied the masses he said, "I myself am an upper pillar of state; my family accumulates tens of thousands in gold — I have reached the utmost in wealth and rank and seek nothing."
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan stationed troops at the Ministry of the Masters of Writing; whenever he rallied the masses he said, "I myself am an upper pillar of state; my family accumulates tens of thousands in gold — I have reached the utmost in wealth and rank and want nothing more."

sentences.zh: 今者不顧破家滅族者，為天下解倒懸之急，救黎元之命耳。

translations.literal: Now I disregard the destruction of family and clan because the realm hangs upside down in urgent peril and the lives of the black-haired people must be saved.
translations.idiomatic: Now I disregard the destruction of family and clan because the realm hangs upside down in urgent peril and the lives of the black-haired people must be saved, the record states.

sentences.zh: 」眾皆悅，詣轅門請自效者日數千。

translations.literal: The masses were all pleased; those who came to the camp gate daily requesting to serve numbered in the thousands.
translations.idiomatic: The masses were all pleased; those who came to the camp gate daily requesting to serve numbered in the thousands, the record states.

sentences.zh: 及與樊子蓋書曰：

translations.literal: When he wrote to Fan Zigai he said:
translations.idiomatic: In his letter to Fan Zigai he wrote:

sentences.zh: 夫建忠立義，事有多途，見機而作，蓋非一揆。

translations.literal: Establishing loyalty and righteousness has many paths; seizing opportunity and acting is surely not one measure alone.
translations.idiomatic: Establishing loyalty and righteousness has many paths; seizing opportunity and acting is surely not one measure alone, the record states.

sentences.zh: 昔伊尹放太甲于桐宮，霍光廢劉賀於昌邑，此並公度內，不能一二披陳。

translations.literal: In old times Yi Yin placed Tai Jia in the Tong Palace and Huo Guang deposed Liu He in Changyi — these were all within public measure and cannot be fully set forth one by one.
translations.idiomatic: In old times Yi Yin placed Tai Jia in the Tong Palace and Huo Guang deposed Liu He in Changyi — these were all within public measure and cannot be fully set forth one by one, the record states.

sentences.zh: 高祖文皇帝誕膺天命，造茲區宇，在ＦＭ璣以齊七政，握金鏡以馭六龍，無為而至化流，垂拱而天下乂。

translations.literal: High Ancestor Emperor Wen received Heaven's mandate and created this realm; he aligned the celestial pearl to harmonize the seven regulators and grasped the golden mirror to drive the six dragons — through non-action transformation flowed, through draped sleeves the realm was governed.
translations.idiomatic: High Ancestor Emperor Wen received Heaven's mandate and created this realm; he aligned the celestial pearl to harmonize the seven regulators and grasped the golden mirror to drive the six dragons — through non-action transformation flowed, through draped sleeves the realm was governed, the record states.

sentences.zh: 今上纂承寶曆，宜固洪基，乃自絕於天，殄人敗德。

translations.literal: The present ruler inherits the precious succession and should consolidate the great foundation, yet he himself cuts off from Heaven and destroys men and ruins virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The present ruler inherits the precious succession and should consolidate the great foundation, yet he himself cuts off from Heaven and destroys men and ruins virtue, the record states.

sentences.zh: 頻年肆眚，盜賤於是滋多；

translations.literal: Year after year he grants amnesties, and bandits therefore multiply;
translations.idiomatic: Year after year he grants amnesties, and bandits therefore grow more numerous;

sentences.zh: 所在修營，人力為之凋盡。

translations.literal: wherever construction is undertaken, human strength is exhausted to the last.
translations.idiomatic: wherever construction is undertaken, human strength is exhausted to the last, the record states.

sentences.zh: 荒淫酒色，子女必被其侵；

translations.literal: Indulging in debauchery, wine, and women — daughters must suffer his violation;
translations.idiomatic: Indulging in debauchery, wine, and women — daughters must suffer his advances;

sentences.zh: 耽玩鷹犬，禽獸皆離其毒。

translations.literal: addicted to hawks and dogs — birds and beasts all suffer his poison.
translations.idiomatic: addicted to hawks and dogs — birds and beasts all suffer his poison, the record states.

sentences.zh: 朋黨相扇，貸賄公行，納邪佞之言，杜正直之口。

translations.literal: Factions fan one another; bribes walk openly; he accepts the words of the wicked and flatterers and stops the mouths of the upright.
translations.idiomatic: Factions fan one another; bribes walk openly; he accepts the words of the wicked and flatterers and stops the mouths of the upright, the record states.

sentences.zh: 加以轉輸不息，徭役無期；

translations.literal: Added to this, transport and relay never cease and corvée labor has no term;
translations.idiomatic: Added to this, transport and relay never cease and corvée labor has no end;

sentences.zh: 士卒填溝壑，骸骨蔽原野；

translations.literal: soldiers fill ditches and gullies and bones cover the open fields;
translations.idiomatic: soldiers fill ditches and gullies while bones cover the open fields;

sentences.zh: 黃河之北則千里無煙，江、淮之間則鞠為茂草。

translations.literal: north of the Yellow River for a thousand li there is no smoke; between the Yangzi and Huai it has become luxuriant grass.
translations.idiomatic: north of the Yellow River for a thousand li there is no smoke; between the Yangzi and Huai it has become luxuriant grass, the record states.

sentences.zh: 玄感世荷國恩，位居上將。

translations.literal: Xuangan for generations has received the state's grace and occupies the rank of upper general.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan for generations has received the state's grace and occupies the rank of upper general, the record states.

sentences.zh: 先公奉遺詔曰：「好子孫為我輔弼之，惡子孫為我屏黜之。

translations.literal: My late father received the deathbed edict saying, "Good sons and grandsons — make them my assistants; wicked sons and grandsons — make them my screen and remove them."
translations.idiomatic: My late father received the deathbed edict: "Good sons and grandsons — make them my assistants; wicked sons and grandsons — make them my screen and remove them."

sentences.zh: 」所以上稟先旨，下順人心，廢此淫昏，更立明哲。

translations.literal: Therefore above I uphold the late intent, below I follow men's hearts, deposing this debauched ruler and installing another wise and bright one.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore above I uphold the late intent, below I follow men's hearts, deposing this debauched ruler and installing another wise and bright one, the record states.

sentences.zh: 今四海同心，九有咸應，士卒用命，如赴私仇，人庶相趨，義形公道。

translations.literal: Now the four seas share one heart and the nine regions all respond; soldiers obey orders as if answering a private feud; people and commoners hurry together, righteousness taking the form of public duty.
translations.idiomatic: Now the four seas share one heart and the nine regions all respond; soldiers obey orders as if answering a private feud; people and commoners hurry together, righteousness taking the form of public duty, the record states.

sentences.zh: 天意人事，較然可知。

translations.literal: Heaven's intent and men's affairs — compared, they are clearly knowable.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's intent and men's affairs — compared, they are clearly knowable, the record states.

sentences.zh: 公獨害孤城，勢何支久？

translations.literal: You alone harm this isolated city — how long can your strength last?
translations.idiomatic: You alone harm this isolated city — how long can you hold out?

sentences.zh: 願以黔黎在念，社稷為心，勿拘小禮，自貽伊戚。

translations.literal: I wish you would keep the black-haired people in mind and take the altars of state to heart; do not be bound by minor ritual and bring this grief upon yourself.
translations.idiomatic: I wish you would keep the black-haired people in mind and take the altars of state to heart; do not be bound by minor ritual and bring this grief upon yourself, the record states.

sentences.zh: 誰謂國家，一旦至此！

translations.literal: Who would have said the state would one day come to this!
translations.idiomatic: Who would have thought the state would one day come to this!

sentences.zh: 執筆潸然，言無所具。

translations.literal: Taking up the brush with tears streaming, words cannot fully express.
translations.idiomatic: Taking up the brush with tears streaming, words cannot fully express, the record states.

sentences.zh: 遂進逼東都城。

translations.literal: He then advanced and pressed the eastern capital city.
translations.idiomatic: He then advanced and pressed the eastern capital city, the record states.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書衛玄率眾自關中來援東都，以步騎二萬度瀍、澗挑戰。

translations.literal: Minister of Punishments Wei Xuan led troops from Guanzhong to rescue the eastern capital and with twenty thousand foot and horse soldiers crossed Chan and Jian to challenge battle.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Punishments Wei Xuan led troops from Guanzhong to rescue the eastern capital and with twenty thousand foot and horse soldiers crossed Chan and Jian to challenge battle, the record states.

sentences.zh: 玄感偽北，玄逐之，伏兵發，前軍盡沒。

translations.literal: Xuangan feigned retreat north; Xuan pursued him; ambush troops sprang up and the vanguard was entirely destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan feigned retreat north; Xuan pursued him; ambush troops sprang up and the vanguard was entirely destroyed, the record states.

sentences.zh: 後數日，玄復與玄感戰。

translations.literal: Several days later Xuan again fought Xuangan.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later Xuan again fought Xuangan, the record states.

sentences.zh: 兵始合，玄感詐令人大呼曰：「官軍已得玄感矣。

translations.literal: As the armies were just joining battle, Xuangan had someone shout loudly, "The official army has already captured Xuangan."
translations.idiomatic: As the armies were just joining battle, Xuangan had someone shout loudly, "The official army has already captured Xuangan!"

sentences.zh: 」玄軍稍怠，玄感與數千騎乘之，大潰，擁八千人而去。

translations.literal: Xuan's army slackened slightly; Xuangan with several thousand horsemen charged them and they were greatly routed; he drove off eight thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan's army slackened slightly; Xuangan with several thousand horsemen charged them and they were greatly routed; he drove off eight thousand men, the record states.

sentences.zh: 玄感驍勇多力，每戰，親運長矛，身先士卒，喑鳴叱吒，所當莫不震懾，論者方之項羽。

translations.literal: Xuangan was fierce and brave with great strength; in every battle he personally wielded the long spear and led from the front, roaring and shouting; none who faced him did not tremble in awe; commentators compared him to Xiang Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan was fierce and brave with great strength; in every battle he personally wielded the long spear and led from the front, roaring and shouting; none who faced him did not tremble in awe; commentators compared him to Xiang Yu, the record states.

sentences.zh: 又善撫馭，士樂致死。

translations.literal: He was also skilled at comforting and controlling; soldiers gladly died for him.
translations.idiomatic: He was also skilled at comforting and controlling; soldiers gladly died for him, the record states.

sentences.zh: 由是戰無不捷。

translations.literal: Because of this he was victorious in every battle.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this he was victorious in every battle, the record states.

sentences.zh: 玄軍日蹙，糧又盡，乃悉眾決戰，陣於北邙，一日間戰十餘合。

translations.literal: Xuan's army was daily pressed; grain was also exhausted; he therefore gathered all troops for a decisive battle and arrayed at Beimang; in one day they fought more than ten engagements.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan's army was daily pressed; grain was also exhausted; he therefore gathered all troops for a decisive battle and arrayed at Beimang; in one day they fought more than ten engagements, the record states.

sentences.zh: 玄感弟玄挺中流矢而斃，玄感稍卻。

translations.literal: Xuangan's younger brother Xuanting was struck by a flying arrow and died; Xuangan retreated somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan's younger brother Xuanting was struck by a flying arrow and died; Xuangan retreated somewhat, the record states.

sentences.zh: 樊子蓋復遣兵攻尚書省，又殺數百人。

translations.literal: Fan Zigai again sent troops to attack the Ministry of the Masters of Writing and killed several hundred more.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zigai again sent troops to attack the Ministry of the Masters of Writing and killed several hundred more, the record states.

sentences.zh: 帝遣武賁郎將陳稜攻元務本于黎陽。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Brave Guard Attendant Chen Leng to attack Yuan Wuben at Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent brave guard attendant Chen Leng to attack Yuan Wuben at Liyang.

sentences.zh: 武衛將軍屈突通屯河陽，左翊衛大將軍宇文述發兵繼進，右驍衛大將軍來護兒復來趙援。

translations.literal: General of the Martial Guard Qu Tu Tong garrisoned Heyang; Left Assistant Guard Grand General Yuwen Shu launched troops in continued advance; Right Agile Guard Grand General Lai Huer also came from Zhao to reinforce.
translations.idiomatic: General of the martial guard Qu Tu Tong garrisoned Heyang; left assistant guard grand general Yuwen Shu launched troops in continued advance; right agile guard grand general Lai Huer also came from Zhao to reinforce.

sentences.zh: 玄感與前戶部尚書李子雄計曰：「屈突通曉兵事，若度河則勝負難決，不如分兵拒之。

translations.literal: Xuangan plotted with former Minister of Revenue Li Zixiong, saying, "Qu Tu Tong understands military affairs; if he crosses the river then victory and defeat will be hard to decide — better to divide troops to resist him."
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan plotted with former minister of revenue Li Zixiong, saying, "Qu Tu Tong understands military affairs; if he crosses the river then victory and defeat will be hard to decide — better to divide troops to resist him."

sentences.zh: 不能濟，則樊、衛失援。

translations.literal: If he cannot cross, then Fan and Wei lose support.
translations.idiomatic: If he cannot cross, then Fan and Wei lose support, the record states.

sentences.zh: 」玄感然之，將拒通。

translations.literal: Xuangan agreed and was about to resist Tong.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan agreed and was about to resist Tong, the record states.

sentences.zh: 子蓋知其謀，數擊其營，玄感不果進。

translations.literal: Zigai knew his plan and repeatedly struck his camp; Xuangan could not advance as planned.
translations.idiomatic: Zigai knew his plan and repeatedly struck his camp; Xuangan could not advance as planned, the record states.

sentences.zh: 通遂濟河，軍於破陵。

translations.literal: Tong thereupon crossed the river and encamped at Poling.
translations.idiomatic: Tong then crossed the river and encamped at Poling.

sentences.zh: 玄感為兩軍，西拒衛玄，東拒屈突通。
