translations.literal: Xuangan made two armies, resisting Wei Xuan in the west and Qu Tu Tong in the east.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan made two armies, resisting Wei Xuan in the west and Qu Tu Tong in the east, the record states.

sentences.zh: 子蓋復出兵大戰，玄感軍頻北。

translations.literal: Zigai again sent troops for a great battle; Xuangan's army repeatedly retreated north.
translations.idiomatic: Zigai again sent troops for a great battle; Xuangan's army repeatedly retreated north, the record states.

sentences.zh: 復與子雄計，子雄勸之直入關中，開永豐倉振貧乏，三輔可指麾而定。

translations.literal: He again plotted with Zixiong; Zixiong urged him to enter Guanzhong directly, open the Yongfeng granary to relieve the poor, and the three auxiliaries could be commanded at a gesture.
translations.idiomatic: He again plotted with Zixiong; Zixiong urged him to enter Guanzhong directly, open the Yongfeng granary to relieve the poor, and the three auxiliaries could be commanded at a gesture, the record states.

sentences.zh: 據有府庫，東面而爭天下，此亦霸王之業。

translations.literal: Holding the treasuries and storehouses and facing east to contend for the realm — this too is the enterprise of a hegemon.
translations.idiomatic: Holding the treasuries and storehouses and facing east to contend for the realm — this too is the enterprise of a hegemon, the record states.

sentences.zh: 會華陰諸楊請為鄉導，玄感遂釋洛陽，西圖關中。

translations.literal: When the Yang clan of Huayin requested to serve as local guides, Xuangan thereupon released Luoyang and turned west to aim at Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yang clan of Huayin requested to serve as local guides, Xuangan then released Luoyang and turned west to aim at Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 宣言已破東都，取關西。

translations.literal: He proclaimed that he had already broken the eastern capital and was taking Guanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed that he had already broken the eastern capital and was taking Guanxi, the record states.

sentences.zh: 宇文述等諸軍躡之。

translations.literal: Yuwen Shu and the other armies pursued him.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Shu and the other armies pursued him, the record states.

sentences.zh: 至弘農宮，父老遮說玄感曰：「宮城空虛，又多積粟，攻之易下。

translations.literal: When they reached Hongnong Palace, elders blocked the way and told Xuangan, "The palace walls are empty and grain is greatly stored — attacking it is easy to take.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached Hongnong Palace, elders blocked the way and told Xuangan, "The palace walls are empty and grain is greatly stored — attacking it is easy to take, the record states.

sentences.zh: 進可絕敵人之食，退可割宜陽之地。

translations.literal: Advancing you can cut off the enemy's food; retreating you can seize the land of Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing you can cut off the enemy's food; retreating you can seize the land of Yiyang, the record states.

sentences.zh: 」玄感以為然，留攻三日，城不下，追兵遂至。

translations.literal: Xuangan thought it correct and stayed to attack for three days; the city did not fall and pursuing troops then arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan thought it correct and stayed to attack for three days; the city did not fall and pursuing troops then arrived, the record states.

sentences.zh: 玄感西至閿鄉，上槃豆，佈陣亙五十里，與官軍且戰且行，一日三敗。

translations.literal: Xuangan went west to Wenxiang, ascended Pandou, and arrayed troops extending fifty li; with the official army he fought while marching and in one day was defeated three times.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan went west to Wenxiang, ascended Pandou, and arrayed troops extending fifty li; with the official army he fought while marching and in one day was defeated three times, the record states.

sentences.zh: 復陣于董杜原，諸軍大敗之。

translations.literal: He again arrayed at Dongdu Plain; the various armies greatly defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: He again arrayed at Dongdu Plain; the various armies greatly defeated him, the record states.

sentences.zh: 玄感獨與十餘騎竄林木間，將奔上洛。

translations.literal: Xuangan alone with more than ten horsemen fled into the forest; he was about to flee to Shangluo.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan alone with more than ten horsemen fled into the forest; he was about to flee to Shangluo, the record states.

sentences.zh: 追騎至，玄感叱之，皆懼而返走。

translations.literal: When pursuing horsemen arrived, Xuangan shouted at them and all feared and turned back to flee.
translations.idiomatic: When pursuing horsemen arrived, Xuangan shouted at them and all feared and turned back to flee, the record states.

sentences.zh: 至葭蘆戍，窘迫，獨與弟積善步行，謂積善曰：「事敗矣，我不能受人戮辱，汝可殺我。

translations.literal: When he reached Jialu Post he was hard pressed; alone with his younger brother Jishan he walked and said to Jishan, "The affair is failed — I cannot suffer the humiliation of being executed by others; you may kill me."
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Jialu Post he was hard pressed; alone with his younger brother Jishan he walked and said to Jishan, "The affair has failed — I cannot suffer the humiliation of being executed by others; you may kill me."

sentences.zh: 」積善殺之，因自刺不死，為追兵所執，與玄感首俱送行在所，磔其屍於東都市，三日，復臠而焚之。

translations.literal: Jishan killed him, then stabbed himself but did not die and was seized by pursuing troops; together with Xuangan's head he was sent to the traveling palace; his corpse was dismembered at the eastern capital market, and after three days was again cut to pieces and burned.
translations.idiomatic: Jishan killed him, then stabbed himself but did not die and was seized by pursuing troops; together with Xuangan's head he was sent to the traveling palace; his corpse was dismembered at the eastern capital market, and after three days was again cut to pieces and burned, the record states.

sentences.zh: 餘黨悉平。

translations.literal: The remaining factions were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining factions were all subdued.

sentences.zh: 其弟玄獎為義陽太守，將歸玄感，為郡丞周旋玉所殺。

translations.literal: His younger brother Xuanjiang was Grand Administrator of Yiyang; about to return to Xuangan, he was killed by Assistant Administrator Zhou Xuan of the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Xuanjiang was grand administrator of Yiyang; about to return to Xuangan, he was killed by assistant administrator Zhou Xuan of the commandery.

sentences.zh: 玄縱弟萬石，自帝所逃歸，至高陽，止傳舍，監事許華與郡兵執之，斬於涿郡。

translations.literal: Xuanzong's younger brother Wanshi fled from the emperor's entourage and returned; reaching Gaoyang he stopped at a relay station; Supervisor Xu Hua with commandery troops seized him and beheaded him in Zhuo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong's younger brother Wanshi fled from the emperor's entourage and returned; reaching Gaoyang he stopped at a relay station; supervisor Xu Hua with commandery troops seized him and beheaded him in Zhuo commandery.

sentences.zh: 萬石弟仁行，官至朝議大夫，斬于長安。

translations.literal: Wanshi's younger brother Renxing, who had attained the rank of Remonstrance and Discussion Grandee, was beheaded at Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Wanshi's younger brother Renxing, who had attained the rank of remonstrance and discussion grandee, was beheaded at Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 並具梟磔。

translations.literal: All were fully dismembered and exposed.
translations.idiomatic: All were fully dismembered and exposed, the record states.

sentences.zh: 公卿請改玄感姓為梟氏，詔可之。

translations.literal: The kings and dukes requested changing Xuangan's surname to the Owl clan; an edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The kings and dukes requested changing Xuangan's surname to the Owl clan; an edict approved it, the record states.

sentences.zh: 玄感之亂，有趙元淑者預謀，誅。

translations.literal: In Xuangan's rebellion there was one Zhao Yuanshu who participated in the plot and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuangan's rebellion there was one Zhao Yuanshu who participated in the plot and was executed, the record states.

sentences.zh: 又有劉元進，亦舉兵應之。

translations.literal: There was also Liu Yuanjin, who likewise raised troops in response.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Liu Yuanjin, who likewise raised troops in response, the record states.

sentences.zh: 元淑，博陵人。

translations.literal: Yuanshu was a man of Boling.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanshu was a man of Boling, the record states.

sentences.zh: 父世模，初從高寶，後以眾歸周，授上開府，寓居京兆之雲陽。

translations.literal: His father Shimu at first followed Gao Bao, then with his troops submitted to Zhou and was appointed Upper Opening General, residing in Yunyang of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shimu at first followed Gao Bao, then with his troops submitted to Zhou and was appointed upper opening general, residing in Yunyang of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 隋文帝踐阼，恆典宿衛。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui ascended the throne, he constantly held night watch in the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Sui ascended the throne, he constantly held night watch in the palace guard, the record states.

sentences.zh: 後從晉王伐陳，力戰而死。

translations.literal: Later he followed the Prince of Jin in attacking Chen and died fighting bitterly.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed the Prince of Jin in attacking Chen and died fighting bitterly, the record states.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以其身死王事，以元淑襲父本官，賜物三千段。

translations.literal: The court because he died in the king's service had Yuanshu inherit his father's former office and gave three thousand lengths of goods.
translations.idiomatic: The court because he died in the king's service had Yuanshu inherit his father's former office and gave three thousand lengths of goods, the record states.

sentences.zh: 元淑性疏誕，不事產業，家徒壁立。

translations.literal: Yuanshu's nature was careless and unrestrained; he did not manage property; his household was bare as a wall.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanshu's nature was careless and unrestrained; he did not manage property; his household was bare as a wall, the record states.

sentences.zh: 後授驃騎將軍，將之官，無以自給。

translations.literal: Later he was appointed General of Agile Cavalry and was about to take up office but had no means to support himself.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was appointed general of agile cavalry and was about to take up office but had no means to support himself.

sentences.zh: 時長安富人宗連家累千金，仕周為三原令，有季女，慧而有色。

translations.literal: At that time the rich man of Chang'an Zong Lian's family accumulated thousands in gold; he had served Zhou as Magistrate of Sanyuan and had a youngest daughter, clever and beautiful.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the rich man of Chang'an Zong Lian's family accumulated thousands in gold; he had served Zhou as magistrate of Sanyuan and had a youngest daughter, clever and beautiful.

sentences.zh: 連每求賢夫，聞元淑，請與相見。

translations.literal: Lian repeatedly sought a worthy son-in-law; hearing of Yuanshu he requested a meeting.
translations.idiomatic: Lian repeatedly sought a worthy son-in-law; hearing of Yuanshu he requested a meeting, the record states.

sentences.zh: 連有風儀，美談笑，元淑亦慕之。

translations.literal: Lian had bearing and grace and spoke elegantly; Yuanshu also admired him.
translations.idiomatic: Lian had bearing and grace and spoke elegantly; Yuanshu also admired him, the record states.

sentences.zh: 及至其家，服玩居處，擬於將相，酒酣，奏女樂，元淑所未見也。

translations.literal: When he reached his house, clothing, playthings, dwelling, and surroundings rivaled those of generals and ministers; when the wine was deep, female musicians performed — something Yuanshu had never seen.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached his house, clothing, playthings, dwelling, and surroundings rivaled those of generals and ministers; when the wine was deep, female musicians performed — something Yuanshu had never seen, the record states.

sentences.zh: 及出，連又致殷勤。

translations.literal: When he left, Lian again showed great cordiality.
translations.idiomatic: When he left, Lian again showed great cordiality, the record states.

sentences.zh: 元淑再三來，宴樂更侈於前。

translations.literal: Yuanshu came again several times; feasts and music were even more extravagant than before.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanshu came again several times; feasts and music were even more extravagant than before, the record states.

sentences.zh: 因問所須，盡買與之，元淑致謝，連復拜求以女妻之。

translations.literal: He therefore asked what was needed and bought everything for him; Yuanshu expressed thanks, and Lian again bowed requesting to give him his daughter in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore asked what was needed and bought everything for him; Yuanshu expressed thanks, and Lian again bowed requesting to give him his daughter in marriage, the record states.

sentences.zh: 元淑感而納焉，遂為富人。

translations.literal: Yuanshu was moved and accepted her, and thereby became a rich man.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanshu was moved and accepted her, and thereby became a rich man, the record states.

sentences.zh: 從楊素平楊諒，以功進位柱國，曆德州刺史、潁川太守，並有威惠。

translations.literal: Following Yang Su in pacifying Yang Liang, for merit his rank was advanced to Pillar of State; he passed through Regional Inspector of De Province and Grand Administrator of Yingchuan, all with authority and kindness.
translations.idiomatic: Following Yang Su in pacifying Yang Liang, for merit his rank was advanced to pillar of state; he passed through regional inspector of Dezhou and grand administrator of Yingchuan, all with authority and kindness.

sentences.zh: 入為司農卿。

translations.literal: He entered court as Minister of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as minister of agriculture.

sentences.zh: 玄感有異志，遂與結交。

translations.literal: Xuangan had rebellious intent and therefore formed friendship with him.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan had rebellious intent and therefore formed friendship with him, the record states.

sentences.zh: 遼東之役，領將軍、典宿衛，加光祿大夫，封葛國公。

translations.literal: In the Liaodong campaign he led generals and held night watch in the palace guard, with the added rank of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and enfeoffment as Duke of Ge State.
translations.idiomatic: In the Liaodong campaign he led generals and held night watch in the palace guard, with the added rank of grand master of splendid happiness and enfeoffment as Duke of Ge State.

sentences.zh: 明年，帝復征高麗，以元淑鎮監渝。

translations.literal: The next year the emperor again campaigned against Goguryeo and made Yuanshu garrison and supervise Linyu.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the emperor again campaigned against Goguryeo and made Yuanshu garrison and supervise Linyu, the record states.

sentences.zh: 及玄感作亂，其弟玄縱自駕所逃歸，路經臨渝。

translations.literal: When Xuangan rebelled, his younger brother Xuanzong fled from the imperial carriage and returned; on the road he passed Linyu.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuangan rebelled, his younger brother Xuanzong fled from the imperial carriage and returned; on the road he passed Linyu, the record states.

sentences.zh: 元淑出其小妻魏氏見玄縱，對宴極歡，因與通謀，並受玄縱賂遺。

translations.literal: Yuanshu brought out his concubine Lady Wei to meet Xuanzong; they feasted together in extreme merriment and therefore plotted together, both accepting bribes from Xuanzong.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanshu brought out his concubine Lady Wei to meet Xuanzong; they feasted together in extreme merriment and therefore plotted together, both accepting bribes from Xuanzong, the record states.

sentences.zh: 及玄感敗，人有告其事者，帝以屬吏，元淑及魏氏俱斬於涿郡，籍沒其家。

translations.literal: When Xuangan was defeated someone reported the matter; the emperor turned him over to the officials; Yuanshu and Lady Wei were both beheaded in Zhuo Commandery and their property was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuangan was defeated someone reported the matter; the emperor turned him over to the officials; Yuanshu and Lady Wei were both beheaded in Zhuo commandery and their property was confiscated.

sentences.zh: 元進，余杭人。

translations.literal: Yuanjin was a man of Yuhang.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjin was a man of Yuhang, the record states.

sentences.zh: 少好任俠，為州裏所宗，兩手各長尺餘，臂垂過膝。

translations.literal: From youth he loved chivalry and was honored by his district; each hand was more than a foot long and his arms hung past his knees.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he loved chivalry and was honored by his district; each hand was more than a foot long and his arms hung past his knees, the record states.

sentences.zh: 屬遼東之役，百姓騷動，元進自以相表非常，遂聚亡命。

translations.literal: During the Liaodong campaign the common people were disturbed; Yuanjin considered his physiognomy extraordinary and therefore gathered fugitives.
translations.idiomatic: During the Liaodong campaign the common people were disturbed; Yuanjin considered his physiognomy extraordinary and therefore gathered fugitives, the record states.

sentences.zh: 會玄感起于黎陽，元進應之。

translations.literal: When Xuangan rose at Liyang, Yuanjin responded to him.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuangan rose at Liyang, Yuanjin responded to him, the record states.

sentences.zh: 旬月，眾至數萬，將度江而玄感敗。

translations.literal: Within ten days and a month the masses reached tens of thousands; he was about to cross the river when Xuangan was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Within ten days and a month the masses reached tens of thousands; he was about to cross the river when Xuangan was defeated, the record states.

sentences.zh: 吳郡硃燮、晉陵管崇亦舉兵，有眾七萬，共迎元進，奉以為主。

translations.literal: Zhu Xie of Wu Commandery and Guan Chong of Jinling also raised troops with a force of seventy thousand; together they welcomed Yuanjin and installed him as leader.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Xie of Wu commandery and Guan Chong of Jinling also raised troops with a force of seventy thousand; together they welcomed Yuanjin and installed him as leader.

sentences.zh: 據吳郡，稱為天子，以燮、崇俱為僕射，署百官。

translations.literal: Holding Wu Commandery he styled himself Son of Heaven; he made Xie and Chong both Vice Directors and appointed the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: Holding Wu commandery he styled himself Son of Heaven; he made Xie and Chong both vice directors and appointed the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 帝令將軍吐萬緒、光祿大夫魚俱羅討焉。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered General Tuwann Xu and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Yu Juluo to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered General Tuwann Xu and grand master of splendid happiness Yu Juluo to attack them.

sentences.zh: 為緒所敗，硃燮戰死。

translations.literal: He was defeated by Xu; Zhu Xie died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Xu defeated him; Zhu Xie died in battle.

sentences.zh: 俄而緒、俱羅並得罪。

translations.literal: Before long both Xu and Juluo were condemned for offenses.
translations.idiomatic: Before long both Xu and Juluo were condemned for offenses, the record states.

sentences.zh: 江都郡丞王世充發兵擊之。

translations.literal: Assistant Administrator of Jiangdu Commandery Wang Shichong launched troops to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant administrator of Jiangdu commandery Wang Shichong launched troops to attack them.

sentences.zh: 有大流星墜于江都，未及地而南逝，磨拂竹木皆有聲，至吳郡而落於地。

translations.literal: A great meteor fell at Jiangdu; before reaching the ground it sped south, grinding bamboo and trees with a sound all the way, and fell to earth at Wu Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: A great meteor fell at Jiangdu; before reaching the ground it sped south, grinding bamboo and trees with a sound all the way, and fell to earth at Wu commandery.

sentences.zh: 元進惡之，令掘地入二丈得一石，徑丈餘。

translations.literal: Yuanjin hated this and ordered the ground dug two zhang deep, obtaining a stone more than a zhang in diameter.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjin hated this and ordered the ground dug two zhang deep, obtaining a stone more than a zhang in diameter, the record states.

sentences.zh: 數日，失石所在。

translations.literal: Several days later the stone's whereabouts were lost.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later the stone's whereabouts were lost, the record states.

sentences.zh: 世充度江，元進遣兵人各持茅，因風縱火。

translations.literal: Shichong crossed the river; Yuanjin sent soldiers each holding straw and, using the wind, set fires.
translations.idiomatic: Shichong crossed the river; Yuanjin sent soldiers each holding straw and, using the wind, set fires, the record states.

sentences.zh: 世充大懼，將棄營。

translations.literal: Shichong was greatly afraid and was about to abandon the camp.
translations.idiomatic: Shichong was greatly afraid and was about to abandon the camp, the record states.

sentences.zh: 遇反風火轉，元進眾懼燒而退，世充大破之。

translations.literal: Meeting a reverse wind the fire turned; Yuanjin's masses feared being burned and retreated; Shichong greatly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Meeting a reverse wind the fire turned; Yuanjin's masses feared being burned and retreated; Shichong greatly defeated them, the record states.

sentences.zh: 元進及崇俱為世充所殺。

translations.literal: Yuanjin and Chong were both killed by Shichong.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjin and Chong were both killed by Shichong, the record states.

sentences.zh: 世充坑其眾于黃亭澗，死者三萬人。

translations.literal: Shichong buried his masses in a pit at Huangting Stream; the dead numbered thirty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Shichong buried the dead in a pit at Huangting Stream; the dead numbered thirty thousand.

sentences.zh: 其後董道沖、沈法興、李子通等並乘此而起。

translations.literal: Afterward Dong Daochong, Shen Faxiang, Li Zitong, and others all took advantage of this to rise.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Dong Daochong, Shen Faxiang, Li Zitong, and others all took advantage of this to rise, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素母弟約。

translations.literal: Su's younger brother by the same mother was Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Su's younger brother by the same mother was Yue, the record states.

sentences.zh: 約字惠伯。

translations.literal: Yue, style name Huibo.
translations.idiomatic: Yue, styled Huibo.

sentences.zh: 童兒時嘗登樹，墜地為查傷，由是竟為宦者。

translations.literal: As a child he once climbed a tree, fell to the ground, and was injured by a branch; because of this he ended up a eunuch.
translations.idiomatic: As a child he once climbed a tree, fell to the ground, and was injured by a branch; because of this he ended up a eunuch, the record states.

sentences.zh: 性如沈靜，內多譎詐，好學強記。

translations.literal: His nature was deep and quiet, inwardly much deceitful; he loved learning and had a strong memory.
translations.idiomatic: His nature was deep and quiet, inwardly much deceitful; he loved learning and had a strong memory, the record states.

sentences.zh: 素友愛之，凡有所為，先籌於約而行。

translations.literal: Su loved and trusted him; whatever he undertook he first planned with Yue before acting.
translations.idiomatic: Su loved and trusted him; whatever he undertook he first planned with Yue before acting, the record states.

sentences.zh: 在周末，以素軍功賜爵安成縣公，拜上儀同三司。

translations.literal: At the end of Zhou he because of Su's military merit was ennobled Baron of Ancheng County and appointed Upper Honors Equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Zhou he because of Su's military merit was ennobled baron of Ancheng and appointed upper honors equal to the three excellencies.

sentences.zh: 文帝受禪，歷位長秋卿、鄜州刺史、宗正、大理三少卿。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen received the abdication he passed through the posts of Director of the Palace Women's Bureau, Regional Inspector of Fu Province, Director of the Imperial Clan, and three Vice Directors of the Court of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen received the abdication he passed through the posts of director of the palace women's bureau, regional inspector of Fuzhou, director of the imperial clan, and three vice directors of the court of justice.

sentences.zh: 時皇太子無寵，晉王廣規奪宗，以素幸於上而雅信約，乃用張衡計，遣宇文述大以金寶賂約，因通王意，說之曰：「夫守正履道，固人臣之常致；

translations.literal: At that time the crown prince had no favor; the Prince of Jin Guang plotted to seize the succession; because Su was favored by the emperor and deeply trusted Yue, he used Zhang Heng's plan and sent Yuwen Shu with great gold and jewels to bribe Yue, thereby conveying the prince's intent and persuading him, saying, "Upholding correctness and treading the Way is indeed the constant attainment of a minister;
translations.idiomatic: At that time the crown prince had no favor; the Prince of Jin Guang plotted to seize the succession; because Su was favored by the emperor and deeply trusted Yue, he used Zhang Heng's plan and sent Yuwen Shu with great gold and jewels to bribe Yue, thereby conveying the prince's intent and persuading him, saying, "Upholding correctness and treading the Way is the constant attainment of a minister;

sentences.zh: 反經合義，亦達者之令圖。

translations.literal: Going against the canon and joining with righteousness is also the excellent design of the far-sighted.
translations.idiomatic: Going against the canon and joining with righteousness is also the excellent design of the far-sighted, the record states.

sentences.zh: 自古賢人君子，莫不與時消息，以避禍患。

translations.literal: Since ancient times worthy men and gentlemen have all moved with the times to avoid disaster and harm.
translations.idiomatic: Since ancient times worthy men and gentlemen have all moved with the times to avoid disaster and harm, the record states.

sentences.zh: 公兄弟功名蓋世，用事有年，朝臣為足下家所屈辱者，可勝數哉？

translations.literal: Your brothers' achievement and fame cover the age; you have held power for years — can the court ministers humiliated by your household be counted?
translations.idiomatic: Your brothers' achievement and fame cover the age; you have held power for years — can the court ministers humiliated by your household even be counted?

sentences.zh: 又儲宮以所欲不行，每切齒於執政。

translations.literal: Also the heir apparent, because his wishes are not carried out, constantly gnashes his teeth at those in power.
translations.idiomatic: Also the heir apparent, because his wishes are not carried out, constantly gnashes his teeth at those in power, the record states.

sentences.zh: 公雖自結於人主，而欲危公者亦多矣。

translations.literal: Though you attach yourself to the ruler, those who wish to endanger you are also many.
translations.idiomatic: Though you attach yourself to the ruler, those who wish to endanger you are also many, the record states.

sentences.zh: 主上一旦棄群臣，公亦何以取庇？

translations.literal: If the ruler one day abandons his ministers, how will you find shelter?
translations.idiomatic: If the ruler one day abandons his ministers, where will you find shelter?

sentences.zh: 今皇太子失愛于皇后，主上素有廢黜之心，此公所知也。

translations.literal: Now the crown prince has lost the empress's love; the ruler has long had intent to depose him — this you know.
translations.idiomatic: Now the crown prince has lost the empress's love; the ruler has long had intent to depose him — this you know, the record states.

sentences.zh: 今若請立晉王，在賢兄之口耳。

translations.literal: Now if you request installing the Prince of Jin, it is only a word from your worthy elder brother.
translations.idiomatic: Now if you request installing the Prince of Jin, it is only a word from your worthy elder brother, the record states.

sentences.zh: 誠能因此時建大功，王必鎮銘於骨髓，斯則去累卵之危，成太山之安也。

translations.literal: If you can thereby at this time establish great merit, the prince will surely inscribe it in marrow and bone — then you escape the peril of an egg piled up and achieve the security of Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: If you can thereby at this time establish great merit, the prince will surely inscribe it in marrow and bone — then you escape the peril of an egg piled up and achieve the security of Mount Tai, the record states.

sentences.zh: 」約然之，又白素。

translations.literal: Yue agreed and again told Su.
translations.idiomatic: Yue agreed and reported again to Su.

sentences.zh: 素本凶險，聞之大喜，乃撫掌曰：「吾智慧殊不及此，賴汝起餘。

translations.literal: Su by nature was fierce and dangerous; hearing this he was greatly pleased and clapped his hands, saying, "My wisdom is far inferior to this — I rely on you to rouse me."
translations.idiomatic: Su by nature was fierce and dangerous; hearing this he was greatly pleased and clapped his hands, saying, "My wisdom falls far short of this — I rely on you to rouse me."

sentences.zh: 」約知其計行，復謂素曰：「今皇后之言，上無不用，宜因機會，早自結托，則匪惟長保榮祿，傳祚子孫。

translations.literal: Yue knowing his plan would succeed again told Su, "Now the empress's words — the emperor uses none he rejects; you should seize the opportunity and early attach yourself, then not only will you long preserve rank and emolument but pass the succession to sons and grandsons.
translations.idiomatic: Yue knowing his plan would succeed again told Su, "Now the empress's words — the emperor uses none he rejects; you should seize the opportunity and early attach yourself, then not only will you long preserve rank and emolument but pass the succession to sons and grandsons, the record states.

sentences.zh: 又晉王傾身禮士，聲名日盛；

translations.literal: Also the Prince of Jin bends his body to honor scholars and his reputation grows daily;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Prince of Jin bends his body to honor scholars and his reputation grows daily;

sentences.zh: 躬履節儉，有主上之風。

translations.literal: personally practicing thrift, he has the bearing of the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: personally practicing thrift, he has the bearing of the ruler, the record states.

sentences.zh: 以約料之，必能安天下。

translations.literal: By Yue's reckoning he will surely be able to settle the realm.
translations.idiomatic: By Yue's reckoning he will surely be able to settle the realm, the record states.

sentences.zh: 兄若遲疑，一旦有變，令太子用事，恐禍至無日。

translations.literal: If elder brother hesitates, once there is a change and the crown prince holds power, I fear disaster will come within days.
translations.idiomatic: If elder brother hesitates, once there is a change and the crown prince holds power, I fear disaster will come within days, the record states.

sentences.zh: 」素遂行其策，太子果廢。

translations.literal: Su thereupon carried out this strategy; the crown prince was indeed deposed.
translations.idiomatic: Su then carried out this strategy; the crown prince was indeed deposed.

sentences.zh: 及帝在東都，令約詣京師享廟，行至華陰，見其先墓。

translations.literal: When the emperor was at the eastern capital he ordered Yue to go to the capital to offer sacrifices at the ancestral temple; traveling to Huayin he saw his ancestors' tombs.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was at the eastern capital he ordered Yue to go to the capital to offer sacrifices at the ancestral temple; traveling to Huayin he saw his ancestors' tombs, the record states.

sentences.zh: 遂枉道拜哭，為憲司所劾，坐免官。

translations.literal: He thereupon left the road to bow and weep and was impeached by the censorate; he sat condemned and was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: He then left the road to bow and weep and was impeached by the censorate; he sat condemned and was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 尋拜浙陽太守。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed Grand Administrator of Zheyang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed grand administrator of Zheyang.

sentences.zh: 其兄子玄感時為禮部尚書，與約恩義甚篤，既愴分離，形於顏色。

translations.literal: His elder brother's son Xuangan at that time was Minister of Rites; with Yue his bond of kindness and duty was very deep; grieved at separation, it showed on his face.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother's son Xuangan at that time was minister of rites; with Yue his bond of kindness and duty was very deep; grieved at separation, it showed on his face.

sentences.zh: 帝謂曰：「公比憂瘁，得非為叔也？

translations.literal: The emperor said, "You seem more sorrowful than usual — is it not because of your uncle?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "You seem more sorrowful than usual — is it not because of your uncle? — so he said."

sentences.zh: 」玄感再拜流涕曰：「誠如聖旨。

translations.literal: Xuangan bowed again with streaming tears and said, "It is indeed as Your Majesty says."
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan bowed again with streaming tears and said, "It is truly as Your Majesty says."

sentences.zh: 」帝亦思約廢立功，由是征入朝。

translations.literal: The emperor also remembered Yue's merit in deposing the heir and establishing the successor, and therefore summoned him to court.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also remembered Yue's merit in deposing the heir and establishing the successor, and therefore summoned him to court, the record states.

sentences.zh: 未幾卒，以素子玄挺後之。

translations.literal: Before long he died; Su's son Xuanting was made his heir.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was dead; Su's son Xuanting was made his heir.

sentences.zh: 穆字紹叔，暄弟也。

translations.literal: Mu, style name Shaoshu, was Xuan's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Mu, styled Shaoshu, was Xuan's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 仕魏，華州別駕。

translations.literal: He served Wei as Vice Administrator of Hua Province.
translations.idiomatic: He served Wei as vice administrator of Hua Province.

sentences.zh: 孝武末，弟寬請以澄城縣伯讓穆，詔許之。

translations.literal: Late in Emperor Xiaowu's reign his younger brother Kuan requested to give Mu the barony of Chengcheng County; an edict permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Emperor Xiaowu's reign his younger brother Kuan requested to give Mu the barony of Chengcheng; an edict permitted it.

sentences.zh: 終於并州刺史，贈開府儀同三司、華州刺史。

translations.literal: He ended his career as Regional Inspector of Bing Province and was posthumously awarded Opening General with Honors Equal to the Three Excellencies and Regional Inspector of Hua Province.
translations.idiomatic: He ended his career as regional inspector of Bingzhou and was posthumously honored as opening general with honors equal to the three excellencies and regional inspector of Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 穆弟儉，字景則。

translations.literal: Mu's younger brother Jian, style name Jingze.
translations.idiomatic: Mu's younger brother Jian, styled Jingze.

sentences.zh: 偉容儀，有才行。

translations.literal: Imposing in appearance and bearing, he had talent and conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Imposing in appearance and bearing, he had talent and conduct, the record states.

sentences.zh: 位北雍州刺史，政尚寬惠，夷夏安之。

translations.literal: He was Regional Inspector of Northern Yong Province; his government valued generosity and kindness; barbarians and Chinese were all settled.
translations.idiomatic: He was regional inspector of Northern Yong; his government valued generosity and kindness; barbarians and Chinese were all settled.

sentences.zh: 後從破齊神武于沙苑，封夏陽縣侯，位開府儀同三司、華州刺史。

translations.literal: Later he followed in defeating Qi founder Gao Huan at Shaya and was enfeoffed Marquis of Xiayang; he held the rank of Opening General with Honors Equal to the Three Excellencies and Regional Inspector of Hua Province.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed in defeating Qi founder Gao Huan at Shaya and was enfeoffed marquis of Xiayang; he held the rank of opening general with honors equal to the three excellencies and regional inspector of Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡靜。

translations.literal: When he died his posthumous name was Jing.
translations.idiomatic: When he died his posthumous name was Jing (Calm).

sentences.zh: 子異，字文殊。

translations.literal: His son Yi, style name Wenshu.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yi, styled Wenshu.

sentences.zh: 美風儀，有器局。

translations.literal: Fine in bearing and grace, he had capacity and measure.
translations.idiomatic: Fine in bearing and grace, he had capacity and measure, the record states.

sentences.zh: 髫齔就學，日誦千言，見者奇之。

translations.literal: While still in infancy he went to study; each day he recited a thousand words; those who saw him marveled.
translations.idiomatic: While still in infancy he went to study; each day he recited a thousand words; those who saw him marveled, the record states.

sentences.zh: 九歲丁父憂，哀毀過禮，殆將滅性。

translations.literal: At nine he entered mourning for his father; grief and destruction exceeded ritual and nearly extinguished his life.
translations.idiomatic: At nine he entered mourning for his father; grief and destruction exceeded ritual and nearly extinguished his life, the record states.

sentences.zh: 及免喪之後，絕慶吊，閉戶讀書。

translations.literal: After the mourning period ended he ceased congratulations and condolences and closed his door to read books.
translations.idiomatic: After the mourning period ended he ceased congratulations and condolences and closed his door to read books, the record states.

sentences.zh: 數年之間，博涉書記。

translations.literal: Within several years he broadly mastered books and records.
translations.idiomatic: Within several years he broadly mastered books and records, the record states.

sentences.zh: 周閔帝時，為甯都郡太守，甚有能名，賜爵樂昌縣子，後數以軍功進爵為侯。

translations.literal: In the time of Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou he was Grand Administrator of Ningdu Commandery, very renowned for ability; he was ennobled Baron of Lechang County, and later several times for military merit his rank was advanced to marquis.
translations.idiomatic: In the time of Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou he was grand administrator of Ningdu, very renowned for ability; he was ennobled baron of Lechang, and later several times for military merit his rank was advanced to marquis.

sentences.zh: 隋文帝作相，行濟州事。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui was chief minister he handled affairs of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Sui was chief minister he handled affairs of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 及踐阼，拜宗正少卿，加上開府。

translations.literal: When he ascended the throne he was appointed Vice Director of the Imperial Clan and given Upper Opening General.
translations.idiomatic: When he ascended the throne he was appointed vice director of the imperial clan and given upper opening general.

sentences.zh: 蜀王秀之鎮益州也，朝廷盛選綱紀，以異方直，拜益州總管長史，尋遷西南道行台兵部尚書。

translations.literal: When Prince of Shu Xiu garrisoned Yizhou the court greatly selected overseers; because Yi was upright he was appointed Chief Clerk of the Area Commander of Yizhou, and soon transferred to Minister of War of the Southwest Route Mobile Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince of Shu Xiu garrisoned Yizhou the court greatly selected overseers; because Yi was upright he was appointed chief clerk of the area commander of Yizhou, and soon transferred to minister of war of the Southwest Route Mobile Headquarters.

sentences.zh: 後曆宗正卿、刑部尚書，出為吳州總管，甚有能名。

translations.literal: Later he passed through Director of the Imperial Clan and Minister of Punishments and went out as Area Commander of Wu Province, very renowned for ability.
translations.idiomatic: Later he passed through director of the imperial clan and minister of punishments and went out as area commander of Wuzhou, very renowned for ability.

sentences.zh: 時晉王廣鎮揚州，詔令異每歲一與王相見，評論得失，規諫疑闕。

translations.literal: At that time the Prince of Jin Guang garrisoned Yangzhou; an edict ordered Yi once each year to meet with the prince, discuss gains and losses, and remonstrate regarding doubts and omissions.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Prince of Jin Guang garrisoned Yangzhou; an edict ordered Yi once each year to meet with the prince, discuss gains and losses, and remonstrate regarding doubts and omissions, the record states.

sentences.zh: 卒於官。

translations.literal: He died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He died while in office.

sentences.zh: 子虔遜。

translations.literal: His son Qianxun.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Qianxun.

sentences.zh: 寬子蒙仁，儉弟也。

translations.literal: Kuan's son Mengren was Jian's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Kuan's son Mengren was Jian's younger brother, the record states.

sentences.zh: 少有大志，每與諸兒童遊處，必擇高大之物坐之，見者咸異焉。

translations.literal: From youth he had great ambition; whenever he played with other children he always chose the tallest object to sit on; those who saw him all marveled.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he had great ambition; whenever he played with other children he always chose the tallest object to sit on; those who saw him all marveled, the record states.

sentences.zh: 及長，頗解屬文，尤尚武藝。

translations.literal: When grown he was fairly skilled at composing prose and especially valued martial arts.
translations.idiomatic: When grown he was fairly skilled at composing prose and especially valued martial arts, the record states.

sentences.zh: 弱冠，除奉朝請。

translations.literal: At the capping age he was appointed Attendant at Court Audience.
translations.idiomatic: At the capping age he was appointed attendant at court audience.

sentences.zh: 父鈞出鎮恆州，請隨從展效，乃授高闕戍主。

translations.literal: His father Jun went out to garrison Heng Province and requested to follow and show merit; he was therefore appointed Commandant of Gaokai Pass.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jun went out to garrison Hengzhou and requested to follow and show merit; he was therefore appointed commandant of Gaokai Pass.

sentences.zh: 既而蠕蠕亂，共主阿那瑰奔魏，魏帝詔鈞衛送，寬亦從行。

translations.literal: Before long the Rouran were in disorder; their ruler Anagui fled to Wei; Emperor Wen of Wei ordered Jun to escort and guard him, and Kuan also followed on the journey.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Rouran were in disorder; their ruler Anagui fled to Wei; Emperor Wen of Wei ordered Jun to escort and guard him, and Kuan also followed on the journey, the record states.

sentences.zh: 時北邊賊起，攻圍鎮城。

translations.literal: At that time bandits rose on the northern frontier and besieged the garrison city.
translations.idiomatic: At that time bandits rose on the northern frontier and besieged the garrison city, the record states.

sentences.zh: 鈞卒，城人等推寬守禦。

translations.literal: Jun died; the people of the city and others pushed Kuan to defend.
translations.idiomatic: Jun died; the people of the city and others pushed Kuan to defend, the record states.

sentences.zh: 尋而城陷，寬乃北走蠕蠕，後討六鎮賊破，寬始得還朝。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the city fell; Kuan fled north to the Rouran; later when the Six Garrisons bandits were defeated Kuan was able to return to court.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the city fell; Kuan fled north to the Rouran; later when the Six Garrisons bandits were defeated Kuan was able to return to court, the record states.

sentences.zh: 廣陽王深與寬素相昵，深犯法得罪，寬被逮捕。

translations.literal: Prince of Guangyang Shen was naturally intimate with Kuan; Shen violated the law and was condemned; Kuan was arrested.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Guangyang Shen was naturally intimate with Kuan; Shen violated the law and was condemned; Kuan was arrested, the record states.

sentences.zh: 孝莊為侍中，與寬有舊，藏之於宅，遇赦得免。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaozhuang as attendant-in-ordinary had old ties with Kuan and hid him in his residence; meeting an amnesty he escaped punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozhuang as attendant-in-ordinary had old ties with Kuan and hid him in his residence; meeting an amnesty he escaped punishment, the record states.

sentences.zh: 除宗正丞。

translations.literal: He was appointed Assistant Director of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed assistant director of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 北海王顥少相器重，時為大行臺北征葛榮，欲啟寬為左丞。

translations.literal: Prince of Beihai Hao from youth greatly valued him; at that time as Grand Mobile Headquarters he marched north to attack Ge Rong and wished to appoint Kuan left assistant.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Beihai Hao from youth greatly valued him; at that time as grand mobile headquarters he marched north to attack Ge Rong and wished to appoint Kuan left assistant.

sentences.zh: 寬辭以孝莊厚恩未報，義不見利而動。

translations.literal: Kuan declined, saying Emperor Xiaozhuang's deep kindness had not been repaid and righteousness did not move for profit.
translations.idiomatic: Kuan declined, saying Emperor Xiaozhuang's deep kindness had not been repaid and righteousness did not move for profit, the record states.

sentences.zh: 顥未之許，顥妹婿李神軌謂顥曰：「匹夫猶不可奪志，況義士乎。

translations.literal: Hao did not agree; Hao's brother-in-law Li Shengui told Hao, "Even a common man cannot have his resolve taken — how much more a man of righteousness."
translations.idiomatic: Hao did not agree; Hao's brother-in-law Li Shengui told Hao, "Even a common man cannot have his resolve broken — how much more a man of righteousness."

sentences.zh: 」乃止。

translations.literal: Thereupon he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Then he stopped.

sentences.zh: 孝莊踐阼，累遷洛陽令，以都督從太宰、上党王元穆討平邢杲。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaozhuang ascended the throne Kuan rose in stages to Magistrate of Luoyang and as area commander followed Grand Preceptor, Prince of Shangdang Yuan Mu in suppressing and pacifying Xing Gao.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozhuang ascended the throne Kuan rose in stages to magistrate of Luoyang and as area commander followed Grand Preceptor, Prince of Shangdang Yuan Mu in suppressing and pacifying Xing Gao.

sentences.zh: 師未還。

translations.literal: The army had not yet returned.
translations.idiomatic: The army had not returned yet.

sentences.zh: 屬元顥入洛，莊帝出居河內。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Emperor Zhuang went out to reside at Henei.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Emperor Zhuang went out to reside at Henei, the record states.

sentences.zh: 天穆懼，集諸將謀之。

translations.literal: Mu was afraid and gathered the generals to plot.
translations.idiomatic: Mu was afraid and gathered the generals to plot, the record states.

sentences.zh: 寬勸天穆徑取成皋，會兵伊、洛。

translations.literal: Kuan urged Mu to go directly to take Chenggao and assemble troops at Yi and Luo.
translations.idiomatic: Kuan urged Mu to go directly to take Chenggao and assemble troops at Yi and Luo, the record states.

sentences.zh: 天穆然之，乃趣成皋，令寬與爾硃兆為後拒。

translations.literal: Mu agreed and therefore hurried to Chenggao, ordering Kuan and Erzhu Zhao to serve as rear guard.
translations.idiomatic: Mu agreed and therefore hurried to Chenggao, ordering Kuan and Erzhu Zhao to serve as rear guard, the record states.

sentences.zh: 尋以眾議不同，乃回赴石濟。

translations.literal: Soon because popular opinion differed they turned back and went to Shiji.
translations.idiomatic: Soon because popular opinion differed they turned back and went to Shiji, the record states.

sentences.zh: 寬夜行失道，遂後期，諸將咸言寬少與北海周旋，今不來矣。

translations.literal: Kuan traveled by night and lost the road, therefore arriving late; the generals all said Kuan in youth had dealings with Beihai and now would not come.
translations.idiomatic: Kuan traveled by night and lost the road, therefore arriving late; the generals all said Kuan in youth had dealings with Beihai and now would not come, the record states.

sentences.zh: 天穆答曰：「楊寬非輕去就者也，吾當為諸君明之。

translations.literal: Mu replied, "Yang Kuan is not one to lightly leave or stay; I shall make this clear to you all."
translations.idiomatic: Mu replied, "Yang Kuan is not one to lightly leave or stay; I shall explain this to you all."

sentences.zh: 」言訖，候騎白寬至。

translations.literal: When he finished speaking, scouts reported Kuan had arrived.
translations.idiomatic: When he finished speaking, scouts reported Kuan had arrived, the record states.

sentences.zh: 天穆撫髀而笑曰：「吾固知其必來。

translations.literal: Mu stroked his thigh and laughed, saying, "I always knew he would come."
translations.idiomatic: Mu stroked his thigh and laughed, saying, "I knew all along he would come."

sentences.zh: 」遽出帳迎，握其手曰：「是所望也」與天穆俱謁孝莊於太行。

translations.literal: He immediately went out of the tent to welcome him, grasped his hand and said, "This is what I hoped for," and together with Mu paid respects to Emperor Xiaozhuang at Taihang.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately went out of the tent to welcome him, grasped his hand and said, "This is what I hoped for," and together with Mu paid respects to Emperor Xiaozhuang at Taihang, the record states.

sentences.zh: 仍為都督，從平河內，進圍北中。

translations.literal: He was again made area commander and followed in pacifying Henei and advancing to besiege Northern Center.
translations.idiomatic: He was again made area commander and followed in pacifying Henei and advancing to besiege Northern Center, the record states.

sentences.zh: 時梁陳慶之為顥勒兵守北門，天穆駐馬圍外，遣寬至城下說慶之，不答，久之乃曰：「賢兄撫軍在，頗欲相見不？

translations.literal: At that time Liang's Chen Qingzhi for Hao mustered troops to guard the north gate; Mu halted his horse outside the encirclement and sent Kuan below the walls to persuade Qingzhi; he did not answer; after a long while he finally said, "Your worthy elder brother the Pacification General is here — do you not wish to meet him?"
translations.idiomatic: At that time Liang's Chen Qingzhi for Hao mustered troops to guard the north gate; Mu halted his horse outside the encirclement and sent Kuan below the walls to persuade Qingzhi; he did not answer; after a long while he finally said, "Your worthy elder brother the Pacification General is here — do you not wish to meet him? — so he said."

sentences.zh: 」寬答：「僕兄既力屈凶威，跡淪逆黨，人臣之理，何煩相見。

translations.literal: Kuan answered, "My elder brother has already exhausted his strength against fierce power and his traces have sunk into the rebel faction — the principle of a minister; why trouble to meet."
translations.idiomatic: Kuan answered, "My elder brother has already exhausted his strength against fierce power and his traces have sunk into the rebel faction — such is the principle of a minister; why trouble to meet."

sentences.zh: 」天穆聞之，自此彌敬。

translations.literal: When Mu heard this he from this time respected Kuan ever more.
translations.idiomatic: When Mu heard this he from this time respected Kuan ever more, the record states.

sentences.zh: 孝莊反正，除太府卿、華州大中正，封澄城縣伯。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaozhuang was restored to correctness he was appointed Director of the Imperial Treasury and Senior Rectifier of Hua Province and enfeoffed Baron of Chengcheng County.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozhuang was restored to correctness he was appointed director of the imperial treasury and senior rectifier of Hua Province and enfeoffed baron of Chengcheng.

sentences.zh: 爾硃榮被誅，其從弟世澄等出據河橋，還逼京師，進寬使持節、大都督，隨機捍禦。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Rong was executed his younger cousin Shicheng and others went out and held Heliang, again pressing the capital; Kuan was advanced and sent as Bearer of the Staff of Authority and Grand Area Commander to resist as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong was executed his younger cousin Shicheng and others went out and held Heliang, again pressing the capital; Kuan was advanced and sent as bearer of the staff of authority and grand area commander to resist as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 世隆謂寬曰：「豈忘大宰相知之深也？

translations.literal: Shilong said to Kuan, "Have you forgotten how deeply the Grand Chancellor knew you?"
translations.idiomatic: Shilong said to Kuan, "Have you forgotten how deeply the Grand Chancellor knew you? — so he said."

sentences.zh: 」寬答曰：「太宰見愛以禮，人臣之交耳，今日之事，事君之節。

translations.literal: Kuan answered, "The Grand Preceptor treated me with love through ritual — the exchange of minister and subject. Today's affair is the integrity of serving one's ruler."
translations.idiomatic: Kuan answered, "The Grand Preceptor treated me with love through ritual — that is the exchange of minister and subject. Today's affair is the integrity of serving one's ruler."

sentences.zh: 」及爾硃兆陷洛陽，囚執孝莊帝，寬還洛不可，遂自成皋奔梁。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Zhao took Luoyang and imprisoned Emperor Xiaozhuang, Kuan could not return to Luoyang and therefore from Chenggao fled to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Zhao took Luoyang and imprisoned Emperor Xiaozhuang, Kuan could not return to Luoyang and therefore from Chenggao fled to Liang, the record states.

sentences.zh: 至建鄴，聞莊帝弑崩，寬發喪盡禮，梁武義之。

translations.literal: Reaching Jiankang he heard Emperor Zhuang had been murdered; Kuan observed mourning with full ritual; Emperor Wu of Liang commended his righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Jiankang he heard Emperor Zhuang had been murdered; Kuan observed mourning with full ritual; Emperor Wu of Liang commended his righteousness, the record states.

sentences.zh: 尋而禮送還。

translations.literal: Before long he was sent back with ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was sent back with full ceremony.

sentences.zh: 孝武初，除給事黃門侍郎。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Xiaowu he was appointed Gentlemen-in-Attendance of the Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Xiaowu he was appointed gentlemen-in-attendance of the yellow gate.

sentences.zh: 孝武與齊神武有隙，遂召募驍勇，廣增宿衛，以寬為閣內大都督，專總禁旅。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu had a rift with Qi founder Gao Huan and therefore recruited fierce warriors and broadly increased palace guard; he made Kuan Grand Area Commander Within the Gate and exclusively commanded the forbidden troops.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu had a rift with Qi founder Gao Huan and therefore recruited fierce warriors and broadly increased palace guard; he made Kuan grand area commander within the gate and exclusively commanded the forbidden troops.

sentences.zh: 從孝武入關，兼吏部尚書，錄從駕勳，進爵華山郡公。

translations.literal: Following Emperor Xiaowu into Guanzhong he was concurrently Minister of the Masters of Writing and recorded merit of those who followed the imperial carriage; his rank was advanced to Duke of Huashan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Following Emperor Xiaowu into Guanzhong he was concurrently minister of the Masters of Writing and recorded merit of those who followed the imperial carriage; his rank was advanced to Duke of Huashan.

sentences.zh: 大統初，遷太子太傅。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Great Unity he was transferred to Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Great Unity he was transferred to junior tutor of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 五年，除驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、都督、東雍州刺史，即本州也。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed General of Agile Cavalry, Opening General with Honors Equal to the Three Excellencies, Area Commander, and Regional Inspector of Eastern Yong Province — his native province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed general of agile cavalry, opening general with honors equal to the three excellencies, area commander, and regional inspector of Eastern Yong — his native province.

sentences.zh: 廢帝初，為尚書左僕射、將作大監，坐事免。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Fei he was Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Grand Supervisor of Construction and sat condemned and was dismissed for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Fei he was left vice director of the Masters of Writing and grand supervisor of construction and sat condemned and was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 周明帝初，拜大將軍，從駕蘭祥討吐谷渾，破之，別封宜陽縣公。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Ming of Zhou he was appointed General-in-Chief, followed the emperor on the Lanxiang campaign against Tuyuhun, defeated them, and was separately enfeoffed Duke of Yiyang County.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Ming of Zhou he was appointed general-in-chief, followed the emperor on the Lanxiang campaign against Tuyuhun, defeated them, and was separately enfeoffed duke of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 除小塚宰，轉禦正中大夫。

translations.literal: He was appointed Lesser Grand Regent and transferred to Director of the Imperial Carriages Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed lesser grand regent and transferred to director of the imperial carriages bureau.

sentences.zh: 武成二年，詔寬與麟趾殿學士參定經籍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Wucheng an edict ordered Kuan together with scholars of the Linqiu Hall to collate and fix the classics.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Wucheng an edict ordered Kuan together with scholars of the Linqiu Hall to collate and fix the classics, the record states.

sentences.zh: 寬性通敏，有器幹。

translations.literal: Kuan's nature was penetrating and quick, with capacity and backbone.
translations.idiomatic: Kuan's nature was penetrating and quick, with capacity and backbone, the record states.

sentences.zh: 頻牧數州，號稱清簡。

translations.literal: Repeatedly governing several provinces he was called pure and simple.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly governing several provinces he was called pure and simple, the record states.

sentences.zh: 曆居台閣，有當官之譽。

translations.literal: Passing through posts at the high offices he had the reputation of fulfilling office.
translations.idiomatic: Passing through posts at the high offices he had the reputation of fulfilling office, the record states.

sentences.zh: 然與柳機不協，案成其罪，時論頗以此譏之。

translations.literal: Yet he was not in harmony with Liu Ji and constructed his guilt; public opinion for this reason fairly criticized him.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he was not in harmony with Liu Ji and constructed his guilt; public opinion for this reason fairly criticized him, the record states.

sentences.zh: 保定元年，除總管梁興等十九州諸軍事、梁州刺史。

translations.literal: In the first year of Baoding he was appointed Area Commander of the military affairs of the nineteen provinces of Liang and Xing and Regional Inspector of Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoding he was appointed area commander of the military affairs of the nineteen provinces of Liang and Xing and regional inspector of Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 薨于州，贈華、陝、虞、上、潞五州刺史，諡曰元。

translations.literal: He died in the province and was posthumously awarded Regional Inspector of the five provinces of Hua, Shan, Yu, Shang, and Lu and given the posthumous name Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the province and was posthumously honored as regional inspector of Hua, Shan, Yu, Shang, and Lu provinces and given the posthumous name Yuan (Primary).

sentences.zh: 子文恩。

translations.literal: His son Wen'en.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Wen'en.

sentences.zh: 文恩字溫才。

translations.literal: Wen'en, style name Wenzi.
translations.idiomatic: Wen'en, styled Wenzi.

sentences.zh: 在周，年十一，拜車騎大將軍、儀同三司、散騎常侍。

translations.literal: In Zhou, at eleven he was appointed General of the Cavalry and Chariots, Honors Equal to the Three Excellencies, and Regular Cavaliers-in-Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhou, at eleven he was appointed general of the cavalry and chariots, honors equal to the three excellencies, and regular cavaliers-attendant.

sentences.zh: 尋以父功，封新豐縣子。

translations.literal: Soon because of his father's merit he was enfeoffed Baron of Xinfeng County.
translations.idiomatic: Soon because of his father's merit he was enfeoffed baron of Xinfeng.

sentences.zh: 天和初，行武都太守。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianhe he acted as Grand Administrator of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianhe he acted as grand administrator of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 十姓獠反，文恩討平之。

translations.literal: The Ten-Surname Liao rebelled; Wen'en suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: The Ten-Surname Liao rebelled; Wen'en suppressed and pacified them, the record states.

sentences.zh: 復行翼州事。

translations.literal: He again acted in the affairs of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: He again acted in the affairs of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 党項羌叛，文恩又討平之。

translations.literal: The Tangut Qiang rebelled; Wen'en again suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: The Tangut Qiang rebelled; Wen'en again suppressed and pacified them, the record states.

sentences.zh: 進擊資中、武康、隆山等生獠及東山獠，並破之。

translations.literal: Advancing he attacked the raw Liao of Zizhong, Wukang, Longshan, and the eastern mountain Liao and broke them all.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing he attacked the raw Liao of Zizhong, Wukang, Longshan, and the eastern mountain Liao and broke them all, the record states.

sentences.zh: 從陳王攻齊河陰城，又從武帝攻拔晉州，授上儀同三司，改封承寧縣公。

translations.literal: Following Prince of Chen in attacking Qi at Heyin city, he again followed Emperor Wu in capturing and taking Jin Province and was appointed Upper Honors Equal to the Three Excellencies and his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Chengning County.
translations.idiomatic: Following Prince of Chen in attacking Qi at Heyin city, he again followed Emperor Wu in capturing and taking Jin Province and was appointed upper honors equal to the three excellencies and his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Chengning.

sentences.zh: 壽陽劉叔仁作亂，從清河公宇文神舉討之，戰于鹆專井，在陣禽叔仁。

translations.literal: Shouyang's Liu Shuren rebelled; following Duke of Qinghe Yuwen Shenju he attacked them; fighting at Yuzhuan Well he captured Shuren in the battle line.
translations.idiomatic: Shouyang's Liu Shuren rebelled; following Duke of Qinghe Yuwen Shenju he attacked them; fighting at Yuzhuan Well he captured Shuren in the battle line, the record states.

sentences.zh: 又別從王誼破賊於鯉魚柵。

translations.literal: He also separately followed Wang Yi in defeating bandits at Carp Barrier.
translations.idiomatic: He also separately followed Wang Yi in defeating bandits at Carp Barrier, the record states.

sentences.zh: 後累以軍功遷果毅左旅下大夫。

translations.literal: Later repeatedly for military merit he was transferred to Left Brigade Lower Grand Master of Determination.
translations.idiomatic: Later repeatedly for military merit he was transferred to left brigade lower grand master of determination.

sentences.zh: 隋文帝為丞相，從韋孝寬拒尉遲迥于武陟，與行軍總管宇文述擊走其將李俊，遂解懷州圍。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui was chief minister he followed Wei Xiaokuan in resisting Yuchi Jiong at Wuzhi and with Field Headquarters Commander Yuwen Shu attacked and drove off his general Li Jun, thereby relieving the siege of Huai Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Sui was chief minister he followed Wei Xiaokuan in resisting Yuchi Jiong at Wuzhi and with field headquarters commander Yuwen Shu attacked and drove off his general Li Jun, thereby relieving the siege of Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 破尉遲惇，平鄴城，皆有功，進授上大將軍，改封洛川縣公，尋拜隆州刺史。

translations.literal: He defeated Yuchi Dun, pacified Ye city, all with merit; he was advanced to Upper General-in-Chief, his enfeoffment changed to Duke of Luochuan County, and soon he was appointed Regional Inspector of Long Province.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Yuchi Dun, pacified Ye city, all with merit; he was advanced to upper general-in-chief, his enfeoffment changed to Duke of Luochuan, and soon he was appointed regional inspector of Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 開皇元年，進爵正平郡公。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaihuang his rank was advanced to Duke of Zhengping Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaihuang his rank was advanced to Duke of Zhengping.

sentences.zh: 後為魏州刺史，甚有惠政，及去職，吏人思之，為立碑頌德。

translations.literal: Later he was Regional Inspector of Wei Province with very benevolent government; when he left office officials and people missed him and erected a stele praising his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was regional inspector of Weizhou with very benevolent government; when he left office officials and people missed him and erected a stele praising his virtue.

sentences.zh: 轉冀州刺史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Regional Inspector of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to regional inspector of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 煬帝嗣位，徵為戶部尚書，轉納言，改授右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yang succeeded he was summoned as Minister of Revenue, transferred to Chief Counselor, and changed to appointment as Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yang succeeded he was summoned as minister of revenue, transferred to chief counselor, and changed to appointment as right grand master of splendid happiness.

sentences.zh: 從幸江都宮，以足疾，不堪趨奏，復授戶部尚書，位右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Following the emperor's visit to the Jiangdu Palace, because of foot illness he could not hurry to audience, he was again appointed Minister of Revenue, holding the rank of Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: Following the emperor's visit to the Jiangdu Palace, because of foot illness he could not hurry to audience, he was again appointed minister of revenue, holding the rank of right grand master of splendid happiness.

sentences.zh: 卒官，諡曰定。

translations.literal: He died in office; his posthumous name was Ding.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office; his posthumous name was Ding (Settled).

sentences.zh: 初文恩當襲父爵，自以非嫡，遂讓弟紀，當世多之。

translations.literal: Initially Wen'en was to inherit his father's rank; considering himself not the legitimate son he therefore yielded to his younger brother Ji; men of the age mostly praised this.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Wen'en was to inherit his father's rank; considering himself not the legitimate son he therefore yielded to his younger brother Ji; men of the age mostly praised this, the record states.

sentences.zh: 紀字溫范，少剛正，有器局。

translations.literal: Ji, style name Wenfan, from youth was upright and firm, with capacity and measure.
translations.idiomatic: Ji, styled Wenfan, from youth was upright and firm, with capacity and measure.

sentences.zh: 在周，襲爵華山郡公。

translations.literal: In Zhou he inherited the dukedom of Huashan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhou he inherited the dukedom of Huashan.

sentences.zh: 累遷安州總管長史，將兵迎陳降將王瑗于齊安，與陳將周法尚遇，擊走之，以功進開府。

translations.literal: Rising in stages to Chief Clerk of the Area Commander of An Province, he led troops to welcome Chen's surrendered general Wang Yuan at Qi'an; he met Chen general Zhou Fashang, attacked and drove him off, and for merit was advanced to Opening General.
translations.idiomatic: Rising in stages to chief clerk of the area commander of An Province, he led troops to welcome Chen's surrendered general Wang Yuan at Qi'an; he met Chen general Zhou Fashang, attacked and drove him off, and for merit was advanced to opening general.

sentences.zh: 入為虞部下大夫。

translations.literal: He entered court as Lower Grand Master of the Parks Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as lower grand master of the parks bureau.

sentences.zh: 文帝為丞相，改封汾陰縣公。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen was chief minister his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Fenyin County.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen was chief minister his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Fenyin.

sentences.zh: 從梁睿討王謙，以功進授上大將軍。

translations.literal: Following Liang Rui in attacking Wang Qian he for merit was advanced and appointed Upper General-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Following Liang Rui in attacking Wang Qian he for merit was advanced and appointed upper general-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 曆資州刺史、宗正少卿，坐事除名。

translations.literal: He passed through Regional Inspector of Zi Province and Vice Director of the Imperial Clan and sat condemned and was removed from the registers for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: He passed through regional inspector of Zizhou and vice director of the imperial clan and sat condemned and was removed from the registers for an offense.

sentences.zh: 後尋復其爵位，拜熊州刺史，改封上明郡公。

translations.literal: Later he soon recovered his rank and enfeoffment and was appointed Regional Inspector of Xiong Province; his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Shangming Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Later he soon recovered his rank and enfeoffment and was appointed regional inspector of Xiongzhou; his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Shangming.

sentences.zh: 除宗正卿，兼給事黃門侍郎，判禮部尚書事。

translations.literal: He was appointed Director of the Imperial Clan and concurrently Gentlemen-in-Attendance of the Yellow Gate, adjudicating the affairs of Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed director of the imperial clan and concurrently gentlemen-in-attendance of the yellow gate, adjudicating the affairs of minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 遷荊州總管。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Area Commander of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to area commander of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡曰恭。

translations.literal: When he died his posthumous name was Gong.
translations.idiomatic: When he died his posthumous name was Gong (Respectful).

sentences.zh: 論曰：楊播兄弟俱以忠毅謙謹，荷內外之任；

translations.literal: The commentators say: The brothers of Yang Bo all by loyalty, firmness, humility, and caution bore inner and outer appointments;
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: The brothers of Yang Bo all bore inner and outer appointments through loyalty, firmness, humility, and caution;

sentences.zh: 公卿牧守，榮赫累朝，所謂門生故吏遍於天下。

translations.literal: as kings, dukes, governors, and administrators they were glorious and eminent through successive courts — what is called having student-disciples and former subordinates spread throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: as kings, dukes, governors, and administrators they were glorious and eminent through successive courts — what is called having student-disciples and former subordinates spread throughout the realm, the record states.

sentences.zh: 而言色恂恂，出於誠至；

translations.literal: Yet their words and bearing were respectful and sincere, springing from genuine utmost feeling;
translations.idiomatic: Yet their words and bearing were respectful and sincere, springing from genuine feeling;

sentences.zh: 恭德慎行，為世師範，漢之陳紀，門法所不過焉。

translations.literal: their respectful virtue and cautious conduct were models for the age — Han's Chen Ji, whose family method they did not surpass.
translations.idiomatic: their respectful virtue and cautious conduct were models for the age — Han's Chen Ji, whose family method they did not surpass, the record states.

sentences.zh: 後魏以來，一門而已。

translations.literal: Since Later Wei, one clan alone.
translations.idiomatic: Since Later Wei, one clan alone, the record states.

sentences.zh: 諸子秀立，青紫盈庭，積善之慶，蓋有憑也。

translations.literal: The sons all stood out excellently; blue and purple filled the court — the blessing of accumulated goodness surely had support.
translations.idiomatic: The sons all stood out excellently; blue and purple filled the court — the blessing of accumulated goodness surely had support, the record states.

sentences.zh: 及逆胡擅朝，淫刑肆毒，以斯族而遇斯禍，何報施之反哉。

translations.literal: When the rebellious barbarians monopolized the court and wanton punishments spread poison, for such a clan to meet such disaster — how reversed the recompense and retribution!
translations.idiomatic: When rebel chieftains seized the court and torture ran wild, a family like this suffered a fate so cruel that reward and retribution seemed utterly reversed.

sentences.zh: 愔雅道風流，早同標緻，公望人物所推。

translations.literal: Yin with elegant Way and flowing grace from early on shared the same standard; in public reputation men pushed him forward.
translations.idiomatic: Yin carried an air of refined elegance from youth and was widely admired as a man of promise.

sentences.zh: 夫處亂虐之世，當機衡之重，朝有善政，是也。

translations.literal: To dwell in an age of disorder and cruelty, to hold the weight of the pivots of state — when the court has good government, that is it.
translations.idiomatic: Living in violent times while holding the levers of state, he did help produce sound policies at court.

sentences.zh: 及寄天下之命，托六尺之孤，旬朔未幾，身亡君辱。

translations.literal: When entrusted with the realm's mandate and the six-foot orphan, within ten days and a month not yet passed, he himself died and the ruler was shamed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet once entrusted with the empire and a young emperor, within weeks he was dead and his sovereign disgraced.

sentences.zh: 進不能送往事居，觀幾衛主；

translations.literal: Advancing he could not see off the departed and serve the living, observe the signs and guard the ruler;
translations.idiomatic: He could not, in advance, mourn the dead and serve the living, read the signs, and protect his lord;

sentences.zh: 退不能保身全名，辭寵招福。

translations.literal: retreating he could not preserve his person and complete his name, decline favor and summon blessing.
translations.idiomatic: nor, in retreat, preserve his life and reputation, renounce privilege, and secure safety.

sentences.zh: 朝廷之釁，既已仗義斷恩；

translations.literal: The court's breach of trust — he had already by righteousness severed kindness;
translations.idiomatic: The court had already broken faith, and he had cut ties in the name of duty;

sentences.zh: 猜忌之塗，無容推心受亂。

translations.literal: on the path of suspicion there was no room to give his heart and accept disorder.
translations.idiomatic: on a road of mutual suspicion there was no room to give his heart and accept chaos.

sentences.zh: 是知變通之術，非所長也。

translations.literal: Thus one knows that the art of adapting to change was not his strength.
translations.idiomatic: It shows that flexibility in crisis was not his strong suit.

sentences.zh: 處道少而輕俠，俶儻不羈；

translations.literal: Chudao from youth was lightly chivalric, bold and unrestrained;
translations.idiomatic: Chudao was rakishly chivalrous from youth, bold and unconstrained;

sentences.zh: 兼文武之資，包英奇之略，志懷遠大，以功名自許。

translations.literal: combining the resources of both civil and martial, encompassing heroic and singular stratagems, his resolve embraced the far-reaching and he pledged himself to achievement and fame.
translations.idiomatic: he combined civil and martial talent with daring strategy, aimed high, and measured himself by achievement and fame.

sentences.zh: 屬隋文帝將清六合，委以腹心之寄。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui was about to clarify the six harmonies he entrusted him with the charge of heart and belly.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen set out to unify the realm, he placed Su in the innermost circle of trust.

sentences.zh: 掃妖氛于牛鬥，江海恬波；

translations.literal: He swept demonic vapors from the Ox and Dipper — rivers and seas lay calm;
translations.idiomatic: He cleared rebellion from the south until rivers and seas were calm;

sentences.zh: 摧驍猛于龍庭，匈奴遠遁。

translations.literal: he crushed fierce warriors at the Dragon Court — the Xiongnu fled far away.
translations.idiomatic: he broke the northern warriors until the Xiongnu fled beyond reach.

sentences.zh: 若其夷凶靜亂，功臣莫居其右；

translations.literal: If one considers pacifying the fierce and settling disorder, no meritorious minister stands to his right;
translations.idiomatic: In pacifying rebels and restoring order, no minister ranked above him;

sentences.zh: 覽其奇策高文，足為一時之傑。

translations.literal: viewing his singular stratagems and elevated prose, he is fully a hero of the age.
translations.idiomatic: and in bold plans and fine writing he was a towering figure of his age.

sentences.zh: 然以智詐自立，不由仁義之道，阿諛時主，高下其心。

translations.literal: Yet he established himself by cunning and deceit, not by the Way of benevolence and righteousness; he flattered the ruler of the time and raised or lowered his heart accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he built his power on cunning rather than righteousness, flattering the throne and bending his will to the moment.

sentences.zh: 營構離宮，陷君於奢侈；

translations.literal: He constructed detached palaces and trapped the ruler in extravagance;
translations.idiomatic: He built lavish detached palaces and led the emperor into excess;

sentences.zh: 謀廢塚嫡，致國于傾危。

translations.literal: he plotted to depose the heir of the ancestral shrine and brought the state to leaning peril.
translations.idiomatic: he plotted against the legitimate heir and pushed the dynasty toward collapse.

sentences.zh: 終使宗廟丘墟，市朝霜露，究其禍敗之源，實乃素之由也。

translations.literal: In the end he made the ancestral temple a mound and ruin and the market and court frost and dew; tracing the source of disaster and defeat, it was indeed because of Su.
translations.idiomatic: In the end the ancestral temples lay in ruins and the capital in desolation — and the root of that catastrophe was Su himself.

sentences.zh: 玄感宰相之子，荷恩二世，君之失德，當竭腹心。

translations.literal: Xuangan was a chief minister's son who received grace through two reigns; when the ruler lost virtue he should have exhausted heart and belly.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan, a prime minister's son favored across two reigns, should have given his utmost when the throne went astray.

sentences.zh: 未議致身，先圖問鼎，假稱伊、霍之事，將肆莽、卓之心，人神同疾，敗不旋踵。

translations.literal: Before discussing giving his person he first plotted to ask about the cauldron; falsely claiming the affairs of Yi and Huo, he was about to unleash the heart of Wang Mang and Dong Zhuo — men and spirits alike hated him, and defeat came without turning the heel.
translations.idiomatic: Instead he moved first to seize power, invoking Yi Yin and Huo Guang while acting like Wang Mang or Dong Zhuo; heaven and men alike reviled him, and ruin came at once.

sentences.zh: 昆弟就菹醢之誅，先人受焚如之酷，不亦甚乎。

translations.literal: Brothers received the punishment of minced meat; forebears suffered the agony of burning like fuel — is it not excessive?
translations.idiomatic: Brothers were torn apart in execution and ancestors burned in disgrace — was the punishment not too severe?

sentences.zh: 約外示溫柔，內懷狡算，為蛇畫足，終傾國本，俾無遺育，不亦宜哉。

translations.literal: Yue outwardly showed gentleness while inwardly harbored cunning calculation; drawing legs on a snake, in the end he overturned the state's foundation and left no descendants preserved — is it not fitting?
translations.idiomatic: Yue seemed gentle outwardly yet schemed within; like adding feet to a snake, he undermined the dynasty and left no line surviving — and that too was fitting.

sentences.zh: 寬閑關夷險，竟以功名自卒。

translations.literal: Kuan passed through barriers and perils at leisure and in the end completed his life by achievement and fame.
translations.idiomatic: Kuan moved calmly through danger and ended his days with honor intact.

sentences.zh: 文恩能以爵讓，其殆仁乎。

translations.literal: Wen'en could yield his rank — he was perhaps humane.
translations.idiomatic: Wen'en could yield his inheritance — in that he showed true humanity.
